import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'bun:test';
import { auth } from '@repo/auth';
import { db, notification, notificationDelivery } from '@repo/db';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { api, authedApi, type Api, createProject } from '#tests/helpers/app';
import { signUpTestUser, type TestUser } from '#tests/helpers/auth';
import { resetDb } from '#tests/helpers/db';
import { mcpRpc } from '#tests/helpers/mcp';
import { addProjectMember } from '#tests/helpers/members';
import { createRole } from '#tests/helpers/roles';
import { MAX_COMMENT_EMOJI } from '../../reactions';

// Emoji reactions on a comment: POST /comments/:commentId/reactions adds the caller's,
// DELETE /comments/:commentId/reactions/:emoji removes it, and the feed serves the
// reactions of each comment with it. A new reaction sends the comment's author a
// 'reacted' notification.

interface Setup {
  asOwner: Api;
  owner: TestUser;
  issueId: number;
  commentId: number;
}

async function setup(): Promise<Setup> {
  const owner = await signUpTestUser({ name: 'Owner' });
  const asOwner = authedApi(owner.cookie);
  await createProject(asOwner, { key: 'MKT', name: 'Marketing' });
  const view = await asOwner.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).get();
  const issue = await asOwner
    .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
    .issues.post({ columnId: view.data!.columns[0].id, title: 'Task' });
  const comment = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).comments.post({ body: 'note' });
  return { asOwner, owner, issueId: issue.data!.id, commentId: comment.data!.id };
}

function react(client: Api, commentId: number, emoji: string) {
  return client.comments({ commentId }).reactions.post({ emoji });
}

function unreact(client: Api, commentId: number, emoji: string) {
  return client.comments({ commentId }).reactions({ emoji }).delete();
}

// The reactions the feed serves for one comment.
async function feedReactions(client: Api, issueId: number, commentId: number) {
  const res = await client.issues({ issueId }).feed.get({ query: {} });
  return res.data!.items.find((item) => item.id === commentId)!.reactions;
}

describe('comment reactions', () => {
  beforeEach(resetDb);

  it('adds a reaction and serves it with the comment in the feed', async () => {
    const { asOwner, owner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();

    const res = await react(asOwner, commentId, '👍');
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    const expected = [{ emoji: '👍', users: [{ id: owner.userId, name: 'Owner' }] }];
    expect(res.data).toEqual(expected);
    expect(await feedReactions(asOwner, issueId, commentId)).toEqual(expected);
  });

  it('serves a comment without reactions, and a change-log entry, with an empty list', async () => {
    const { asOwner, issueId } = await setup();
    const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId }).feed.get({ query: {} });
    expect(res.data!.items.map((item) => item.reactions)).toEqual([[], []]);
  });

  it('keeps one reaction when the same member adds the same emoji twice', async () => {
    const { asOwner, commentId } = await setup();
    await react(asOwner, commentId, '👍');

    const res = await react(asOwner, commentId, '👍');
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.data).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(res.data![0].users).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('groups members under one emoji and keeps emoji in the order they first appeared', async () => {
    const { asOwner, owner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();
    const asMember = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT');
    await react(asOwner, commentId, '🎉');
    await react(asMember, commentId, '👍');
    await react(asMember, commentId, '🎉');

    const reactions = await feedReactions(asOwner, issueId, commentId);
    expect(reactions.map((r) => r.emoji)).toEqual(['🎉', '👍']);
    expect(reactions[0].users).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(reactions[0].users[0].id).toBe(owner.userId);
    expect(reactions[1].users).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('serves the reactions of a reply and of an entry of a timeline stretch', async () => {
    const { asOwner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();
    const reply = await asOwner
      .issues({ issueId })
      .comments.post({ body: 'answer', replyToId: commentId });
    await react(asOwner, reply.data!.id, '👀');

    expect((await feedReactions(asOwner, issueId, reply.data!.id))[0].emoji).toBe('👀');
    const grouped = await asOwner.issues({ issueId }).feed.grouped.get({ query: {} });
    const groupedReply = grouped
      .data!.groups.flatMap((group) => group.items)
      .find((item) => item.id === reply.data!.id);
    expect(groupedReply!.reactions[0].emoji).toBe('👀');
    const stretch = await asOwner
      .issues({ issueId })
      .timeline.items.get({ query: { from: '2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' } });
    expect(stretch.data!.find((item) => item.id === reply.data!.id)!.reactions[0].emoji).toBe('👀');
  });

  it('keeps the reactions on a comment that is edited', async () => {
    const { asOwner, commentId } = await setup();
    await react(asOwner, commentId, '👍');

    const edited = await asOwner.comments({ commentId }).patch({ body: 'changed' });
    expect(edited.data!.reactions.map((r) => r.emoji)).toEqual(['👍']);
  });

  it('removes only the caller’s reaction', async () => {
    const { asOwner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();
    const asMember = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT');
    await react(asOwner, commentId, '👍');
    await react(asMember, commentId, '👍');

    expect((await unreact(asMember, commentId, '👍')).status).toBe(204);
    const reactions = await feedReactions(asOwner, issueId, commentId);
    expect(reactions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(reactions[0].users).toHaveLength(1);

    expect((await unreact(asOwner, commentId, '👍')).status).toBe(204);
    expect(await feedReactions(asOwner, issueId, commentId)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('answers 204 when removing a reaction that is not there', async () => {
    const { asOwner, commentId } = await setup();
    expect((await unreact(asOwner, commentId, '👍')).status).toBe(204);
  });

  it('accepts a flag, a keycap, a skin tone and a joined sequence as one emoji', async () => {
    const { asOwner, commentId } = await setup();
    for (const emoji of ['🇺🇦', '1️⃣', '👍🏽', '👨‍👩‍👧‍👦', '❤️']) {
      expect((await react(asOwner, commentId, emoji)).status).toBe(201);
      expect((await unreact(asOwner, commentId, emoji)).status).toBe(204);
    }
  });

  it('rejects text, two emoji, an empty and an over-long value', async () => {
    const { asOwner, commentId } = await setup();
    for (const emoji of ['ok', '👍👍', '👍 ', '', '<b>', '👍'.repeat(40)]) {
      expect((await react(asOwner, commentId, emoji)).status).toBe(400);
    }
  });

  it('takes the maximum number of different emoji and refuses one more', async () => {
    const { asOwner, commentId } = await setup();
    const emojis = Array.from({ length: MAX_COMMENT_EMOJI + 1 }, (_, i) =>
      String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600 + i),
    );
    for (const emoji of emojis.slice(0, MAX_COMMENT_EMOJI)) {
      expect((await react(asOwner, commentId, emoji)).status).toBe(201);
    }

    expect((await react(asOwner, commentId, emojis[MAX_COMMENT_EMOJI])).status).toBe(409);
    const asMember = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT');
    expect((await react(asMember, commentId, emojis[0])).status).toBe(201);
  });

  it('removes the reactions with the comment', async () => {
    const { asOwner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();
    await react(asOwner, commentId, '👍');

    expect((await asOwner.comments({ commentId }).delete()).status).toBe(204);
    expect((await react(asOwner, commentId, '👍')).status).toBe(404);
    const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId }).feed.get({ query: { filter: 'comments' } });
    expect(res.data!.items).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('returns 404 for a missing comment and for a change-log entry', async () => {
    const { asOwner, issueId } = await setup();
    const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId }).feed.get({ query: { filter: 'history' } });
    const entryId = res.data!.items[0].id;

    expect((await react(asOwner, 999999, '👍')).status).toBe(404);
    expect((await react(asOwner, entryId, '👍')).status).toBe(404);
    expect((await unreact(asOwner, entryId, '👍')).status).toBe(404);
  });

  it('lets a member react to another member’s comment', async () => {
    const { asOwner, commentId } = await setup();
    const asMember = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT');
    expect((await react(asMember, commentId, '✅')).status).toBe(201);
  });

  it('denies a non-member and a member who may only read', async () => {
    const { asOwner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();
    await react(asOwner, commentId, '👍');
    const outsider = authedApi((await signUpTestUser()).cookie);
    const reader = await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', {
      name: 'Reader',
      permissions: { work_items: { read: true } },
    });
    const asReader = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT', reader.data!.id);

    expect((await react(outsider, commentId, '👍')).status).toBe(403);
    expect((await unreact(outsider, commentId, '👍')).status).toBe(403);
    expect((await react(asReader, commentId, '👍')).status).toBe(403);
    expect((await unreact(asReader, commentId, '👍')).status).toBe(403);
    expect(await feedReactions(asReader, issueId, commentId)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('moves the revision of the issue when a reaction is added and when it is removed', async () => {
    const { asOwner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();
    const scope = `issue:${issueId}`;
    const rev = async () =>
      (await asOwner.sync.rev.get({ query: { scopes: scope } })).data!.revs[scope];
    const before = await rev();

    await react(asOwner, commentId, '👍');
    const added = await rev();
    expect(added).not.toBe(before);
    await unreact(asOwner, commentId, '👍');
    expect(await rev()).not.toBe(added);
  });

  it('leaves the reactions out of a public share of the issue', async () => {
    const { asOwner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();

    const token = (await asOwner.issues({ issueId }).share.post({ extended: true })).data!.token;

  it('refuses a reaction in an archived project', async () => {

    const archived = await asOwner

    expect(archived.status).toBe(200);

    expect((await react(asOwner, commentId, '👍')).status).toBe(403);

  it('adds and removes a reaction through the MCP tools', async () => {
    const { asOwner, owner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();

    const added = await mcpRpc(key, 'tools/call', {
      name: 'add_comment_reaction',

    expect(await feedReactions(asOwner, issueId, commentId)).toEqual([]);

  describe('notification', () => {

      return res.data!.items;
    }

    it('tells the author who reacted, with which emoji, on which comment', async () => {
      const { asOwner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();
      const asMember = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT');

        await asMember.issues({ issueId }).comments.post({ body: 'mine', replyToId: commentId })

      expect(inbox).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(inbox[0]).toMatchObject({
        type: 'reacted',
        reactionEmoji: '🎉',
        actorUserId: reply.actorUserId,
        actorName: reply.actorName,
        issueId,
        issueCommentId: commentId,
        readAt: null,
      });
      expect(await reactedInbox(asMember)).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('tells nobody about a reaction to their own comment', async () => {
      const { asOwner, commentId } = await setup();
      await react(asOwner, commentId, '👍');
      expect(await reactedInbox(asOwner)).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('tells once per member and comment, with the first emoji', async () => {
      const { asOwner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();
      const asMember = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT');
      const asOther = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT');
      const second = (await asOwner.issues({ issueId }).comments.post({ body: 'more' })).data!;

      await react(asMember, commentId, '👍');
      await react(asMember, commentId, '🎉');
      await unreact(asMember, commentId, '👍');
      await react(asMember, commentId, '👍');
      expect((await reactedInbox(asOwner)).map((item) => item.reactionEmoji)).toEqual(['👍']);

      await react(asOther, commentId, '👍');
      await react(asMember, second.id, '🚀');
      expect(
        (await reactedInbox(asOwner)).map((item) => [item.issueCommentId, item.reactionEmoji]),
      ).toEqual([
        [second.id, '🚀'],
        [commentId, '👍'],
        [commentId, '👍'],
      ]);
    });

    it('skips an author whose role may no longer read work items', async () => {
      const { asOwner, issueId } = await setup();
      const blind = await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', { name: 'Blind', permissions: {} });
      const asMember = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT');
      const comment = (await asMember.issues({ issueId }).comments.post({ body: 'hi' })).data!;
      const changed = await asOwner
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: comment.actorUserId! })
        .patch({ role: 'member', roleId: blind.data!.id });
      expect(changed.status).toBe(204);

      await react(asOwner, comment.id, '👍');

      expect(await reactedInbox(asMember)).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('skips an author who is no longer a member of the project', async () => {
      const { asOwner, issueId } = await setup();
      const asMember = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT');
      const comment = (await asMember.issues({ issueId }).comments.post({ body: 'bye' })).data!;
      const removed = await asOwner
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: comment.actorUserId! })
        .delete();
      expect(removed.status).toBe(204);

      await react(asOwner, comment.id, '👍');

      // No route shows the inbox rows of a member who left.
      expect(await db.select().from(notification).where(eq(notification.type, 'reacted'))).toEqual(
        [],
      );
    });

    it('queues the email only for an author who turned the event on', async () => {
      const { asOwner, issueId, commentId } = await setup();
      const asMember = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT');
      const project = (await asOwner.projects.get()).data!.find((p) => p.key === 'MKT')!;
      await asOwner.teams({ teamId: project.teamId })['notification-settings'].put({
        smtp: {
          enabled: true,
          host: 'smtp.example.com',
          port: 587,
          encryption: 'none',
          username: 'mailer@example.com',
          password: 'secret',
          timeout: null,
        },
      });
      const others = { assigned: true, mentioned: true, commented: true, state_changed: true };
      const prefs = asOwner.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })['notification-preferences'];
      expect(
        (await prefs.put({ emailEvents: others, telegramEvents: others })).data!.emailEvents,
      ).toEqual({ ...others, reacted: false });

      await react(asMember, commentId, '👍');
      // No route reads the outbox, and its rows are what the worker sends.
      expect(await db.select().from(notificationDelivery)).toEqual([]);

      await prefs.put({ emailEvents: { ...others, reacted: true }, telegramEvents: others });
      const second = (await asOwner.issues({ issueId }).comments.post({ body: 'more' })).data!;
      await react(asMember, second.id, '🚀');
      const queued = await db.select().from(notificationDelivery);
      expect(queued).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(queued[0]).toMatchObject({ channel: 'email' });
      expect(queued[0].payload.subject).toContain('reacted to your comment');
      expect(queued[0].payload.text).toContain('with 🚀');
      expect(queued[0].payload.url).toEndWith(`/issue/MKT-1#comment-${second.id}`);
    });
  });
});

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'bun:test';
import { auth } from '@repo/auth';
import { db, team } from '@repo/db';
import { inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { app, authedApi, type Api, createProject } from '#tests/helpers/app';
import { signUpTestUser } from '#tests/helpers/auth';
import { resetDb } from '#tests/helpers/db';
import { addProjectMember } from '#tests/helpers/members';
import { createRole } from '#tests/helpers/roles';
import { emptyPermissions } from '#shared/permissions';
import { readOnlyPermissions, setWorkspaceRoleGrant } from '#shared/workspace-roles';

// GET /issues/search: text search over every project the caller may read work items in.

async function setup() {
  await signUpTestUser();
  const user = await signUpTestUser();
  const api = authedApi(user.cookie);
  await createProject(api, { key: 'MKT', name: 'Marketing' });
  await createProject(api, { key: 'OPS', name: 'Operations' });
  return { user, api };
}

async function createIssue(api: Api, projectKey: string, title: string) {
  const view = await api.projects({ projectKey }).get();
  const res = await api
    .projects({ projectKey })
    .issues.post({ columnId: view.data!.columns[0]!.id, title });
  return res.data!;
}

function search(
  api: Api,
  query: { q: string; limit?: number; perProjectLimit?: number; excludeProjectId?: number },
) {
  return api.issues.search.get({ query });
}

const titles = (res: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof search>>) =>
  res.data?.map((hit) => hit.title).sort();

describe('cross-project issue search', () => {
  beforeEach(resetDb);
  afterEach(() => setWorkspaceRoleGrant('admin', readOnlyPermissions()));

  it('matches issues in every project of the caller, each with its project', async () => {
    const { api } = await setup();
    const mkt = await createIssue(api, 'MKT', 'Zephyr launch');
    await createIssue(api, 'OPS', 'Zephyr rollout');
    await createIssue(api, 'OPS', 'Unrelated');
    await api.issues({ issueId: mkt.id }).archive.post();

    const res = await search(api, { q: 'zephyr' });
    const [ownTeam] = (await api.teams.get()).data!;
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(titles(res)).toEqual(['Zephyr launch', 'Zephyr rollout']);
    expect(res.data!.find((hit) => hit.id === mkt.id)).toMatchObject({
      identifier: `MKT-${mkt.sequenceNumber}`,
      projectKey: 'MKT',
      projectName: 'Marketing',
      projectRef: expect.stringMatching(/\.MKT$/),
      teamName: ownTeam!.name,
      archived: true,
    });
  });

  it('returns the estimate in points with each hit', async () => {
    const { api } = await setup();
    const sized = await createIssue(api, 'MKT', 'Zephyr launch');
    await api.issues({ issueId: sized.id }).patch({ estimatePoints: 1.5 });
    const bare = await createIssue(api, 'OPS', 'Zephyr rollout');

    const res = await search(api, { q: 'zephyr' });
    expect(res.data!.find((hit) => hit.id === sized.id)).toMatchObject({ estimatePoints: 1.5 });
    expect(res.data!.find((hit) => hit.id === bare.id)).toMatchObject({ estimatePoints: null });
  });

  it("leaves out another person's projects", async () => {
    const { api } = await setup();
    await createIssue(api, 'MKT', 'Secret plan');
    const other = authedApi((await signUpTestUser()).cookie);

    const res = await search(other, { q: 'secret' });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.data).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('leaves out a project whose role may not read work items', async () => {
    const { api } = await setup();
    await createIssue(api, 'MKT', 'Shared plan');
    await createIssue(api, 'OPS', 'Shared runbook');
    const reader = await createRole(api, 'MKT', {
      name: 'Reader',
      permissions: { work_items: { read: true } },
    });
    const blind = await createRole(api, 'OPS', { name: 'Blind', permissions: {} });
    const asReader = await addProjectMember(api, 'MKT', reader.data!.id);
    const asBlind = await addProjectMember(api, 'OPS', blind.data!.id);

    expect(titles(await search(asReader, { q: 'shared' }))).toEqual(['Shared plan']);
    expect(titles(await search(asBlind, { q: 'shared' }))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('includes a project reached through a workspace role that reads work items', async () => {
    const owner = await signUpTestUser({ team: false });
    const lead = await signUpTestUser();
    const admin = await signUpTestUser();
    const asLead = authedApi(lead.cookie);
    const project = (await createProject(asLead, { key: 'MKT', name: 'Marketing' })).data!;
    await createIssue(asLead, 'MKT', 'Quarterly report');
    const asAdmin = authedApi(admin.cookie);
    const [adminTeam] = (await asAdmin.teams.get()).data!;
    await db
      .update(team)
      .set({ workspaceId: owner.workspaceId! })
      .where(inArray(team.id, [project.teamId, adminTeam!.id]));
    await authedApi(owner.cookie)
      .workspaces({ workspaceId: owner.workspaceId! })
      .managers.post({ userId: admin.userId });

    expect(titles(await search(authedApi(owner.cookie), { q: 'report' }))).toEqual([
      'Quarterly report',
    ]);
    expect(titles(await search(asAdmin, { q: 'report' }))).toEqual(['Quarterly report']);

    setWorkspaceRoleGrant('admin', emptyPermissions());
    expect(titles(await search(asAdmin, { q: 'report' }))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('resolves "KEY-42" to that project, and a bare number to every project', async () => {
    const { api } = await setup();
    const mkt = await createIssue(api, 'MKT', 'First marketing');
    const ops = await createIssue(api, 'OPS', 'First operations');
    expect(ops.sequenceNumber).toBe(mkt.sequenceNumber);

    const keyed = await search(api, { q: `ops-${ops.sequenceNumber}` });
    expect(keyed.data!.map((hit) => hit.id)).toEqual([ops.id]);
    expect(titles(await search(api, { q: String(mkt.sequenceNumber) }))).toEqual([
      'First marketing',
      'First operations',
    ]);
  });

  it('caps the hits at limit and leaves out the excluded project', async () => {
    const { api } = await setup();
    const ops = await createIssue(api, 'OPS', 'Item four');
    for (const title of ['Item one', 'Item two', 'Item three']) {
      await createIssue(api, 'MKT', title);
    }
    const projectId = (await api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).get()).data!.project.id;

    const capped = await search(api, { q: 'item', limit: 2 });
    expect(capped.data!.map((hit) => hit.projectKey)).toEqual(['MKT', 'MKT']);
    expect((await search(api, { q: 'item', limit: 2, excludeProjectId: projectId })).data).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({ id: ops.id }),
    ]);
  });

  it('takes at most perProjectLimit hits from each project, five by default', async () => {
    const { api } = await setup();
    for (let i = 1; i <= 6; i++) await createIssue(api, 'MKT', `Report ${i}`);
    for (let i = 1; i <= 2; i++) await createIssue(api, 'OPS', `Report ops ${i}`);
    const keysOf = (res: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof search>>) =>
      res.data!.map((hit) => hit.projectKey).sort();

    expect(keysOf(await search(api, { q: 'report' }))).toEqual([
      ...Array<string>(5).fill('MKT'),
      'OPS',
      'OPS',
    ]);
    expect(keysOf(await search(api, { q: 'report', perProjectLimit: 2 }))).toEqual([
      'MKT',
      'MKT',
      'OPS',
      'OPS',
    ]);
    const newest = await search(api, { q: 'report', perProjectLimit: 2 });
    expect(newest.data!.find((hit) => hit.projectKey === 'MKT')!.title).toBe('Report 6');
    expect((await search(api, { q: 'report', limit: 3 })).data).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  it('searches only the project an agent run is bound to', async () => {
    const { user, api } = await setup();
    await createIssue(api, 'MKT', 'Zephyr launch');
    await createIssue(api, 'OPS', 'Zephyr rollout');
    const mkt = (await api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).get()).data!.project.id;
    const other = authedApi((await signUpTestUser()).cookie);
    await createProject(other, { key: 'HR', name: 'People' });
    const hr = (await other.projects({ projectKey: 'HR' }).get()).data!.project.id;
    const bound = (projectId: number) =>
      authedApi(user.cookie, { 'x-agent-project': String(projectId) });

    expect(titles(await search(bound(mkt), { q: 'zephyr' }))).toEqual(['Zephyr launch']);
    expect((await search(bound(hr), { q: 'zephyr' })).data).toEqual([]);
    expect(titles(await search(api, { q: 'zephyr' }))).toEqual(['Zephyr launch', 'Zephyr rollout']);
  });

  it('rejects an empty query', async () => {
    const { user } = await setup();
    const res = await app.handle(
      new Request('http://localhost/issues/search?q=', { headers: { cookie: user.cookie } }),
    );
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
  });

  it('serves the search_issues_all_projects MCP tool over the MCP-enabled projects', async () => {
    const { user, api } = await setup();
    await createIssue(api, 'MKT', 'Older plan');
    await createIssue(api, 'MKT', 'Visible plan');
    await createIssue(api, 'OPS', 'Hidden plan');
    const ops = (await api.projects({ projectKey: 'OPS' }).get()).data!.project;
    await api.teams({ teamId: ops.teamId }).mcp.patch({
      projects: [{ projectId: ops.id, enabled: false }],
    });
    const key = await auth.api.createApiKey({ body: { userId: user.userId, name: 'search' } });

    const response = await app.handle(
      new Request('http://localhost/mcp', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          authorization: `Bearer ${key.key}`,
          'content-type': 'application/json',
          accept: 'application/json, text/event-stream',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          jsonrpc: '2.0',
          id: 1,
          method: 'tools/call',
          params: {
            name: 'search_issues_all_projects',
            arguments: { q: 'plan', perProjectLimit: 1 },
          },
        }),
      }),
    );
    const text = await response.text();
    const { result } = JSON.parse(text.slice(text.indexOf('data: ') + 6)) as {
      result: { structuredContent: { ok: boolean; data: { title: string }[] } };
    };
    expect(result.structuredContent).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
      data: [expect.objectContaining({ title: 'Visible plan', projectKey: 'MKT' })],
    });
    expect(result.structuredContent.data).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

FILE: apps/api/src/modules/issues/__tests__/integration/status-history.test.ts

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'bun:test';
import { authedApi, type Api, createProject } from '#tests/helpers/app';
import { signUpTestUser } from '#tests/helpers/auth';
import { resetDb } from '#tests/helpers/db';

// The stretches an issue spends in a column, kept in issue_status and read back
// through GET /issues/:issueId/timeline and the issue's statusSince. The rows are
// written by the routes that change an issue's column, so every case here builds
// its state through them.

async function setup() {
  const owner = await signUpTestUser({ name: 'Owner' });
  const asOwner = authedApi(owner.cookie);
  await createProject(asOwner, { key: 'MKT', name: 'Marketing' });
  const view = await asOwner.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).get();
  const columns = view.data!.columns;
  return {
    asOwner,
    todoId: columns.find((c) => c.name === 'Todo')!.id,
    startedId: columns.find((c) => c.stateType === 'started')!.id,
    doneId: columns.find((c) => c.stateType === 'completed')!.id,
  };
}

function createIssue(api: Api, columnId: number) {
  return api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).issues.post({ title: 'Task', columnId });
}

function moveIssue(api: Api, issueId: number, columnId: number) {
  return api.issues({ issueId }).patch({ columnId });
}

function timeline(api: Api, issueId: number) {
  return api.issues({ issueId }).timeline.get();
}

describe('issue status history', () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await resetDb();
  });

  it('opens the first stretch where the issue is created, starting when it does', async () => {
    const { asOwner, todoId } = await setup();
    const issue = (await createIssue(asOwner, todoId)).data!;

    const res = await timeline(asOwner, issue.id);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.data!.length).toBe(1);
    expect(res.data![0]).toMatchObject({ status: 'Todo', to: null });
    expect(new Date(res.data![0]!.from).getTime()).toBe(new Date(issue.createdAt).getTime());
  });

  it('closes the open stretch and opens one on every move, leaving a single open one', async () => {
    const { asOwner, todoId, startedId, doneId } = await setup();
    const issue = (await createIssue(asOwner, todoId)).data!;
    await moveIssue(asOwner, issue.id, startedId);
    await moveIssue(asOwner, issue.id, doneId);

    const segments = (await timeline(asOwner, issue.id)).data!;
    expect(segments.map((s) => s.status)).toEqual(['Todo', 'In Progress', 'Done']);
    expect(segments.filter((s) => s.to === null).length).toBe(1);
    expect(segments[2]!.to).toBeNull();
    // The stretches meet: each one ends where the next begins.
    expect(segments[0]!.to).toEqual(segments[1]!.from);
    expect(segments[1]!.to).toEqual(segments[2]!.from);
  });

  it('reads a renamed column as one lane, under the name it carries now', async () => {
    const { asOwner, todoId, startedId } = await setup();
    const issue = (await createIssue(asOwner, todoId)).data!;
    await moveIssue(asOwner, issue.id, startedId);
    await asOwner.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).columns({ columnId: todoId }).patch({
      name: 'Later',
    });
    await moveIssue(asOwner, issue.id, todoId);

    const segments = (await timeline(asOwner, issue.id)).data!;
    expect(segments.map((s) => s.status)).toEqual(['Later', 'In Progress', 'Later']);
  });

  it('keeps the stretches spent in a deleted column, still named', async () => {
    const { asOwner, todoId, startedId } = await setup();
    const issue = (await createIssue(asOwner, todoId)).data!;
    await moveIssue(asOwner, issue.id, startedId);
    await asOwner
      .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
      .columns({ columnId: todoId })
      .delete({ mode: 'delete' });

    const segments = (await timeline(asOwner, issue.id)).data!;
    expect(segments.map((s) => s.status)).toEqual(['Todo', 'In Progress']);
  });

  it('opens a stretch in the target column for every issue a column delete moves', async () => {
    const { asOwner, todoId, startedId } = await setup();
    const first = (await createIssue(asOwner, todoId)).data!;
    const second = (await createIssue(asOwner, todoId)).data!;
    await asOwner
      .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
      .columns({ columnId: todoId })
      .delete({ mode: 'move', targetColumnId: startedId });

    for (const issue of [first, second]) {
      const segments = (await timeline(asOwner, issue.id)).data!;
      expect(segments.map((s) => s.status)).toEqual(['Todo', 'In Progress']);
      expect(segments.filter((s) => s.to === null).length).toBe(1);
    }
  });

  it('sets statusSince to when the issue entered the column it is in now', async () => {
    const { asOwner, todoId, startedId } = await setup();
    const issue = (await createIssue(asOwner, todoId)).data!;
    await moveIssue(asOwner, issue.id, startedId);

    const segments = (await timeline(asOwner, issue.id)).data!;
    const after = (await asOwner.issues({ issueId: issue.id }).get()).data!;
    expect(new Date(after.statusSince).getTime()).toBe(new Date(segments[1]!.from).getTime());
  });

  it('starts statusSince at the creation of an issue that never moved', async () => {
    const { asOwner, todoId } = await setup();
    const issue = (await createIssue(asOwner, todoId)).data!;

    const after = (await asOwner.issues({ issueId: issue.id }).get()).data!;
    expect(new Date(after.statusSince).getTime()).toBe(new Date(issue.createdAt).getTime());
  });
});

FILE: apps/api/src/modules/issues/__tests__/integration/subtasks.test.ts

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'bun:test';
import { db, issue } from '@repo/db';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { authedApi, type Api, createProject } from '#tests/helpers/app';
import { signUpTestUser } from '#tests/helpers/auth';
import { resetDb } from '#tests/helpers/db';

// Subtasks: an issue carries the id of the issue it hangs under (parentId), set on
// create or through an update. Subtasks nest up to 8 levels and stay inside one
// project. An issue's parent, its subtasks and the issues above it come back with the
// issue read (GET /issues/:issueId → `parent` / `subtasks` / `ancestors`); deleting or
// archiving an issue that has subtasks says what happens to them (cascade / detach
// / reassign) or is rejected with a 409.

interface Setup {
  asOwner: Api;
  columnId: number;
  doneColumnId: number;
  canceledColumnId: number;
}

async function setupProject(): Promise<Setup> {
  const owner = await signUpTestUser();
  const asOwner = authedApi(owner.cookie);
  await createProject(asOwner, { key: 'MKT', name: 'Marketing' });
  const view = await asOwner.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).get();
  const columns = view.data!.columns;
  const byState = (stateType: string) => columns.find((c) => c.stateType === stateType)!.id;
  return {
    asOwner,
    columnId: columns[0].id,
    doneColumnId: byState('completed'),
    canceledColumnId: byState('canceled'),
  };
}

function createIssue(client: Api, columnId: number, title = 'Task') {
  return client.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).issues.post({ columnId, title });
}

// A parent with one subtask attached, the shape most of the tests start from.
async function parentWithSubtask(client: Api, columnId: number) {
  const parent = (await createIssue(client, columnId, 'Parent')).data!;
  const subtask = (
    await client.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).issues.post({
      columnId,
      title: 'Subtask',
      parentId: parent.id,
    })
  ).data!;
  return { parent, subtask };
}

function createSubtask(client: Api, columnId: number, parentId: number, title: string) {
  return client.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).issues.post({ columnId, title, parentId });
}

// A chain of issues, each a subtask of the one before: the first is on level 1, the
// last on level `levels`.
async function chain(client: Api, columnId: number, levels: number) {
  const issues = [(await createIssue(client, columnId, 'Level 1')).data!];
  for (let level = 2; level <= levels; level++) {
    const parent = issues[issues.length - 1];
    issues.push((await createSubtask(client, columnId, parent.id, `Level ${level}`)).data!);
  }
  return issues;
}

function setParent(client: Api, issueId: number, parentId: number | null) {
  return client.issues({ issueId }).patch({ parentId });
}

function move(client: Api, issueId: number, columnId: number) {
  return client.issues({ issueId }).patch({ columnId });
}

function setAutomations(client: Api, input: { completeParent: boolean; closeSubtasks: boolean }) {
  return client.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).settings.subtasks.patch(input);
}

async function read(client: Api, issueId: number) {
  const res = await client.issues({ issueId }).get();
  return res.data!;
}

// An issue of a second project, which no issue of the first one may hang under.
async function foreignIssue(client: Api) {
  await createProject(client, { key: 'OPS', name: 'Operations' });
  const view = await client.projects({ projectKey: 'OPS' }).get();
  const res = await client
    .projects({ projectKey: 'OPS' })
    .issues.post({ columnId: view.data!.columns[0].id, title: 'Elsewhere' });
  return res.data!;
}

describe('subtasks', () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await resetDb();
  });

  describe('attach', () => {
    it('creates an issue under a parent and shows the pair from both sides', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      expect(subtask.parentId).toBe(parent.id);
      expect(await read(asOwner, parent.id)).toMatchObject({
        parent: null,
        subtasks: [{ id: subtask.id, identifier: subtask.identifier, title: 'Subtask' }],
      });
      expect(await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).toMatchObject({
        parent: { id: parent.id, identifier: parent.identifier, title: 'Parent' },
        subtasks: [],
      });
    });

    it('attaches an existing issue through an update', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const parent = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Parent')).data!;
      const other = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Other')).data!;

      const res = await setParent(asOwner, other.id, parent.id);
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.data!.parentId).toBe(parent.id);
    });

    it('detaches a subtask when its parent is cleared', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      const res = await setParent(asOwner, subtask.id, null);
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.data!.parentId).toBe(null);
      expect((await read(asOwner, parent.id)).subtasks).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('rejects an issue as its own parent with 400', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const issue = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId)).data!;

      const res = await setParent(asOwner, issue.id, issue.id);
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    });

    it('rejects a parent in another project with 400', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const issue = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId)).data!;
      const outside = await foreignIssue(asOwner);

      const res = await setParent(asOwner, issue.id, outside.id);
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    });

    it('rejects a missing parent with 400', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const issue = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId)).data!;

      const res = await setParent(asOwner, issue.id, 999999);
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    });

    it('nests a subtask under a subtask', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      const other = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Other')).data!;

      const res = await setParent(asOwner, other.id, subtask.id);
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).toMatchObject({
        ancestors: [{ id: parent.id }],
        parent: { id: parent.id },
        subtasks: [{ id: other.id }],
      });
      expect((await read(asOwner, other.id)).ancestors.map((a) => a.id)).toEqual([
        parent.id,
        subtask.id,
      ]);
    });

    it('lists the issues above an issue only inside its project', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const top = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Top')).data!;
      const foreign = await foreignIssue(asOwner);
      const below = (
        await asOwner
          .projects({ projectKey: 'OPS' })
          .issues.post({ columnId: foreign.columnId, title: 'Below', parentId: foreign.id })
      ).data!;
      // The API refuses a parent in another project, so the old data is written directly.
      await db.update(issue).set({ parentId: top.id }).where(eq(issue.id, foreign.id));

      const { ancestors } = await read(asOwner, below.id);
      expect(ancestors.map((ancestor) => ancestor.id)).toEqual([foreign.id]);
    });

    it('moves an issue under another parent together with its subtasks', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      const other = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Other')).data!;

      const res = await setParent(asOwner, parent.id, other.id);
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect((await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).ancestors.map((a) => a.id)).toEqual([
        other.id,
        parent.id,
      ]);
    });

    it('rejects an issue under one of its own subtasks with 400', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const [top, , bottom] = await chain(asOwner, columnId, 3);

      const res = await setParent(asOwner, top.id, bottom.id);
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect((await read(asOwner, top.id)).parentId).toBe(null);
    });

    it('accepts only one of two concurrent changes that together close a cycle', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const a = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'A')).data!;
      const b = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'B')).data!;

      const statuses = await Promise.all([
        setParent(asOwner, a.id, b.id),
        setParent(asOwner, b.id, a.id),
      ]).then((all) => all.map((res) => res.status).sort());
      expect(statuses).toEqual([200, 400]);
    });

    it('accepts a subtask on level 8 and rejects one on level 9 with 400', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const levels = await chain(asOwner, columnId, 8);
      const last = levels[7];
      expect((await read(asOwner, last.id)).ancestors.map((a) => a.id)).toEqual(
        levels.slice(0, 7).map((issue) => issue.id),
      );

      const created = await createSubtask(asOwner, columnId, last.id, 'Level 9');
      expect(created.status).toBe(400);
      const other = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Other')).data!;
      expect((await setParent(asOwner, other.id, last.id)).status).toBe(400);
    });

    it('rejects a move that would put the issue’s subtasks past level 8 with 400', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const levels = await chain(asOwner, columnId, 7);
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      expect((await setParent(asOwner, parent.id, levels[6].id)).status).toBe(400);
      expect((await setParent(asOwner, parent.id, levels[5].id)).status).toBe(200);
      expect((await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).ancestors).toHaveLength(7);
    });

    it('records the change on the subtask and on both parents', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      const next = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Next parent')).data!;

      await setParent(asOwner, subtask.id, next.id);

      const subtaskFeed = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: subtask.id }).feed.get({ query: {} });
      expect(subtaskFeed.data!.items).toContainEqual(
        expect.objectContaining({
          action: 'parent',
          payload: {
            from: { value: parent.identifier, id: parent.id },
            to: { value: next.identifier, id: next.id },
          },
        }),
      );
      const oldParentFeed = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).feed.get({ query: {} });
      expect(oldParentFeed.data!.items).toContainEqual(
        expect.objectContaining({
          action: 'subtask_remove',
          payload: { from: { value: subtask.identifier, id: subtask.id } },
        }),
      );
      const newParentFeed = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: next.id }).feed.get({ query: {} });
      expect(newParentFeed.data!.items).toContainEqual(
        expect.objectContaining({
          action: 'subtask_add',
          payload: { to: { value: subtask.identifier, id: subtask.id } },
        }),
      );
    });

    it('lists a parent’s subtasks by the parentId filter', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Unrelated');

      const res = await asOwner
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .issues.get({ query: { parentId: parent.id } });
      expect(res.data).toMatchObject([{ id: subtask.id, parentId: parent.id }]);
    });
  });

  describe('board', () => {
    it('counts an archived subtask on its parent', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      await asOwner.issues({ issueId: subtask.id }).archive.post();

      const board = await asOwner.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).issues.board.get();
      expect(board.data!.issues).toContainEqual(
        expect.objectContaining({ id: parent.id, subtaskCount: 1 }),
      );
    });
  });

  describe('subtree', () => {
    function subtree(client: Api, ids: number[]) {
      return client
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .issues.subtree.get({ query: { ids: ids.join(',') } });
    }

    it('lists every level under the issue with its parent, archived ones included', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const [top, middle, bottom] = await chain(asOwner, columnId, 3);
      await asOwner.issues({ issueId: bottom.id }).archive.post();

      const res = await subtree(asOwner, [top.id]);
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.data!.map(({ id, parentId, archived }) => ({ id, parentId, archived }))).toEqual([
        { id: middle.id, parentId: top.id, archived: false },
        { id: bottom.id, parentId: middle.id, archived: true },
      ]);
    });

    it('leaves out the issues of another project', async () => {
      const { asOwner } = await setupProject();
      const foreign = await foreignIssue(asOwner);
      await asOwner
        .projects({ projectKey: 'OPS' })
        .issues.post({ columnId: foreign.columnId, title: 'Under', parentId: foreign.id });

      const res = await subtree(asOwner, [foreign.id]);
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.data).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('rejects a non-member with 403', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      const outsider = authedApi((await signUpTestUser({ name: 'Outsider' })).cookie);

      expect((await subtree(outsider, [parent.id])).status).toBe(403);
    });
  });

  describe('delete', () => {
    it('deletes the subtasks with the parent on cascade', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).delete(undefined, {
        query: { subtasks: 'cascade' },
      });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: subtask.id }).get()).status).toBe(404);
    });

    it('keeps the subtasks as ordinary issues on detach', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).delete(undefined, {
        query: { subtasks: 'detach' },
      });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);
      expect(await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).toMatchObject({ parentId: null, parent: null });
    });

    it('moves the subtasks to the new parent on reassign', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      const next = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Next parent')).data!;

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).delete(undefined, {
        query: { subtasks: 'reassign', newParentId: next.id },
      });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);
      expect((await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).parentId).toBe(next.id);
    });

    it('deletes every level under the parent on cascade', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const [top, middle, bottom] = await chain(asOwner, columnId, 3);

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: top.id }).delete(undefined, {
        query: { subtasks: 'cascade' },
      });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: middle.id }).get()).status).toBe(404);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: bottom.id }).get()).status).toBe(404);
    });

    it('finishes a cascade through a parent cycle left in old data', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      // The API refuses a cycle, so the old data is written directly.
      await db.update(issue).set({ parentId: subtask.id }).where(eq(issue.id, parent.id));

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).delete(undefined, {
        query: { subtasks: 'cascade' },
      });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: subtask.id }).get()).status).toBe(404);
    });

    it('leaves a subtask in another project alone on cascade', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const parent = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Parent')).data!;
      const foreign = await foreignIssue(asOwner);
      // The API refuses a parent in another project, so the old data is written directly.
      await db.update(issue).set({ parentId: parent.id }).where(eq(issue.id, foreign.id));

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).delete(undefined, {
        query: { subtasks: 'cascade' },
      });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: foreign.id }).get()).status).toBe(200);
    });

    it('keeps the subtasks of a detached subtask under it', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const [top, middle, bottom] = await chain(asOwner, columnId, 3);

      await asOwner.issues({ issueId: top.id }).delete(undefined, {
        query: { subtasks: 'detach' },
      });
      expect(await read(asOwner, middle.id)).toMatchObject({ parentId: null, ancestors: [] });
      expect((await read(asOwner, bottom.id)).parentId).toBe(middle.id);
    });

    it('rejects a delete that does not say what happens to the subtasks with 409', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).delete();
      expect(res.status).toBe(409);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: subtask.id }).get()).status).toBe(200);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).get()).status).toBe(200);
    });

    it('rejects reassigning the subtasks to the issue being deleted with 400', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).delete(undefined, {
        query: { subtasks: 'reassign', newParentId: parent.id },
      });
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).get()).status).toBe(200);
    });

    it('rejects reassigning the subtasks under one of them with 400 and moves none', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      const second = (await createSubtask(asOwner, columnId, parent.id, 'Second')).data!;
      const nested = (await createSubtask(asOwner, columnId, second.id, 'Nested')).data!;

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).delete(undefined, {
        query: { subtasks: 'reassign', newParentId: nested.id },
      });
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect((await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).parentId).toBe(parent.id);
      expect((await read(asOwner, second.id)).parentId).toBe(parent.id);
    });

    it('rejects a reassign that would nest past level 8 with 400 and moves none', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const levels = await chain(asOwner, columnId, 7);
      const parent = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Parent')).data!;
      const leaf = (await createSubtask(asOwner, columnId, parent.id, 'Leaf')).data!;
      const deep = (await createSubtask(asOwner, columnId, parent.id, 'Deep')).data!;
      await createSubtask(asOwner, columnId, deep.id, 'Under deep');

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).delete(undefined, {
        query: { subtasks: 'reassign', newParentId: levels[6].id },
      });
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect((await read(asOwner, leaf.id)).parentId).toBe(parent.id);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).get()).status).toBe(200);
    });

    it('deletes an issue without subtasks with no choice to make', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const issue = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId)).data!;

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: issue.id }).delete();
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);
    });
  });

  describe('archive', () => {
    it('archives the subtasks with the parent on cascade', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).archive.post({
        subtasks: 'cascade',
      });
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect((await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).archivedAt).not.toBe(null);
    });

    it('keeps the subtasks on the board on detach', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).archive.post({
        subtasks: 'detach',
      });

      expect(await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).toMatchObject({ parentId: null, archivedAt: null });
    });

    it('rejects an archive that does not say what happens to the subtasks with 409', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).archive.post();
      expect(res.status).toBe(409);
      expect((await read(asOwner, parent.id)).archivedAt).toBe(null);
    });

    it('brings the subtasks back when the parent is restored', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).archive.post({ subtasks: 'cascade' });

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).restore.post();
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).toMatchObject({ archivedAt: null });
    });

    it('archives and restores every level under the parent', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const [top, , bottom] = await chain(asOwner, columnId, 3);

      await asOwner.issues({ issueId: top.id }).archive.post({ subtasks: 'cascade' });
      expect((await read(asOwner, bottom.id)).archivedAt).not.toBe(null);

      await asOwner.issues({ issueId: top.id }).restore.post();
      expect((await read(asOwner, bottom.id)).archivedAt).toBe(null);
    });

    it('archives an issue without subtasks with no choice to make', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const issue = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId)).data!;

      const res = await asOwner.issues({ issueId: issue.id }).archive.post();
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    });
  });

  describe('bulk', () => {
    it('rejects a bulk archive that leaves the subtasks unsaid with 409', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      const res = await asOwner
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .issues.bulk.archive.post({ ids: [parent.id] });
      expect(res.status).toBe(409);
      expect((await read(asOwner, parent.id)).archivedAt).toBe(null);
    });

    it('leaves the subtasks of another project’s issue alone', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Anything');
      const outside = await foreignIssue(asOwner);
      const outsideSubtask = (
        await asOwner.projects({ projectKey: 'OPS' }).issues.post({
          columnId: outside.columnId,
          title: 'Outside subtask',

      const res = await asOwner
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: outsideSubtask.id }).get()).status).toBe(200);
      expect((await read(asOwner, outsideSubtask.id)).parentId).toBe(outside.id);
    });

    it('rejects reassigning to an issue the same request removes with 400', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      const alsoRemoved = (await createIssue(asOwner, columnId, 'Also removed')).data!;

      const res = await asOwner.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).issues.bulk.delete.post({
        ids: [parent.id, alsoRemoved.id],
        subtasks: 'reassign',
        newParentId: alsoRemoved.id,

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect((await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).parentId).toBe(parent.id);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: parent.id }).get()).status).toBe(200);
      expect((await asOwner.issues({ issueId: alsoRemoved.id }).get()).status).toBe(200);
    });

    it('detaches the subtasks of a bulk delete', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      const res = await asOwner
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .issues.bulk.delete.post({ ids: [parent.id], subtasks: 'detach' });
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).toMatchObject({ parentId: null });
    });
  });

  describe('close automations', () => {
    it('leaves the hierarchy alone while both automations are off', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId, doneColumnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);

      await move(asOwner, subtask.id, doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, parent.id)).columnId).toBe(columnId);

      await move(asOwner, parent.id, doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).columnId).toBe(doneColumnId);
      await move(asOwner, subtask.id, columnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).columnId).toBe(columnId);
    });

    it('closes the parent in the column its last subtask landed in', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId, doneColumnId, canceledColumnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      const second = (await createSubtask(asOwner, columnId, parent.id, 'Second')).data!;
      await setAutomations(asOwner, { completeParent: true, closeSubtasks: false });

      await move(asOwner, subtask.id, canceledColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, parent.id)).columnId).toBe(columnId);

      await move(asOwner, second.id, doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, parent.id)).columnId).toBe(doneColumnId);
    });

    it('holds the parent open while a subtask is still open', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId, doneColumnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      await createSubtask(asOwner, columnId, parent.id, 'Second');
      await setAutomations(asOwner, { completeParent: true, closeSubtasks: false });

      await move(asOwner, subtask.id, doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, parent.id)).columnId).toBe(columnId);
    });

    it('ignores an archived subtask when closing the parent', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId, doneColumnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      const archived = (await createSubtask(asOwner, columnId, parent.id, 'Archived')).data!;
      await asOwner.issues({ issueId: archived.id }).archive.post();
      await setAutomations(asOwner, { completeParent: true, closeSubtasks: false });

      await move(asOwner, subtask.id, doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, parent.id)).columnId).toBe(doneColumnId);
    });

    it('closes the open subtasks in the column the parent was closed in', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId, doneColumnId, canceledColumnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      const alreadyClosed = (await createSubtask(asOwner, columnId, parent.id, 'Closed')).data!;
      await move(asOwner, alreadyClosed.id, canceledColumnId);
      await setAutomations(asOwner, { completeParent: false, closeSubtasks: true });

      await move(asOwner, parent.id, doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).columnId).toBe(doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, alreadyClosed.id)).columnId).toBe(canceledColumnId);
    });

    it('carries a close down and up from an issue in the middle', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId, doneColumnId } = await setupProject();
      const [top, middle, bottom] = await chain(asOwner, columnId, 3);
      await setAutomations(asOwner, { completeParent: true, closeSubtasks: true });

      await move(asOwner, middle.id, doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, bottom.id)).columnId).toBe(doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, top.id)).columnId).toBe(doneColumnId);
    });

    it('closes every parent up the chain once the last subtask closes', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId, doneColumnId } = await setupProject();
      const [top, middle, bottom] = await chain(asOwner, columnId, 3);
      await setAutomations(asOwner, { completeParent: true, closeSubtasks: false });

      await move(asOwner, bottom.id, doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, middle.id)).columnId).toBe(doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, top.id)).columnId).toBe(doneColumnId);
    });

    it('settles with both automations on', async () => {
      const { asOwner, columnId, doneColumnId } = await setupProject();
      const { parent, subtask } = await parentWithSubtask(asOwner, columnId);
      await setAutomations(asOwner, { completeParent: true, closeSubtasks: true });

      const res = await move(asOwner, parent.id, doneColumnId);
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect((await read(asOwner, parent.id)).columnId).toBe(doneColumnId);
      expect((await read(asOwner, subtask.id)).columnId).toBe(doneColumnId);
    });
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'bun:test';
import { db, issueWatcher } from '@repo/db';
import { and, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { authedApi, type Api, createProject } from '#tests/helpers/app';
import { signUpTestUser } from '#tests/helpers/auth';
import { resetDb } from '#tests/helpers/db';
import { createRole } from '#tests/helpers/roles';
import { createAgent } from '#tests/helpers/agents';

// Who follows an issue. A watcher receives the notifications the issue produces;
// the list comes back with the issue (GET /issues/:issueId → `watchers`) and is
// changed through POST/DELETE /issues/:issueId/watch, which act on the caller,
// or the editor-only /watchers/:userId routes for another human project member.
// Members are subscribed automatically when they create an issue, are assigned
// one, comment on it or are mentioned in it — unless they turned auto-subscribe
// off, and never once they have unwatched it by hand.

interface Member {
  api: Api;
  userId: string;
  username: string;
}

async function setup(): Promise<{ owner: Member; columnId: number }> {
  const u = await signUpTestUser();
  const api = authedApi(u.cookie);
  await createProject(api, { key: 'MKT', name: 'Marketing' });
  const view = await api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).get();
  return {
    owner: { api, userId: u.userId, username: u.username },
    columnId: view.data!.columns[0].id,
  };
}

async function addMember(owner: Member, opts: { roleId?: number } = {}): Promise<Member> {
  const u = await signUpTestUser();
  const invite = await owner.api
    .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
    .invites.post({ email: u.email, role: 'member' });
  const api = authedApi(u.cookie);
  await api.invites({ token: invite.data!.token }).accept.post();
  if (opts.roleId != null) {
    await owner.api
      .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
      .members({ userId: u.userId })
      .patch({ role: 'member', roleId: opts.roleId });
  }
  return { api, userId: u.userId, username: u.username };
}

function createIssue(client: Api, columnId: number, patch: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return client.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).issues.post({ columnId, title: 'Task', ...patch });
}

async function watcherIds(client: Api, issueId: number): Promise<string[]> {
  const res = await client.issues({ issueId }).get();
  return res.data!.watchers.map((w) => w.userId);
}

describe('issue watchers', () => {
  beforeEach(resetDb);

  describe('auto-subscribe', () => {
    it('subscribes the author and the assignee', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const member = await addMember(owner);

      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId, { assigneeUserId: member.userId });

      const ids = await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id);
      expect(ids.sort()).toEqual([owner.userId, member.userId].sort());
    });

    it('keeps the previous assignee subscribed when the issue is handed on', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const first = await addMember(owner);
      const second = await addMember(owner);
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId, { assigneeUserId: first.userId });

      await owner.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).patch({ assigneeUserId: second.userId });

      const ids = await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id);
      expect(ids).toContain(first.userId);
      expect(ids).toContain(second.userId);
    });

    it('subscribes a member who comments', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);

      await member.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).comments.post({ body: 'on it' });

      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).toContain(member.userId);
    });

    it('subscribes a member who is mentioned', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);

      await owner.api
        .issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id })
        .comments.post({ body: `@${member.username} take a look` });

      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).toContain(member.userId);
    });

    it('does not create a hidden watcher row for a mentioned AI agent', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const agent = await createAgent(owner.api, 'MKT', {
        name: 'Watcher Bot',
        username: 'watcher-bot',
        kind: 'external',
      });
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);
      const agentUserId = agent.data!.agent.userId;

      await owner.api
        .issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id })
        .comments.post({ body: '@watcher-bot take a look' });

      const rows = await db
        .select({ userId: issueWatcher.userId })
        .from(issueWatcher)
        .where(and(eq(issueWatcher.issueId, issue.data!.id), eq(issueWatcher.userId, agentUserId)));
      expect(rows).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('leaves out a member who turned auto-subscribe off', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      await member.api.account.preferences.patch({ autoWatch: false });
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);

      await member.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).comments.post({ body: 'on it' });

      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).not.toContain(member.userId);
    });
  });

  describe('watch and unwatch', () => {
    it('subscribes the caller and returns the list', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);

      const res = await member.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).watch.post();

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.data!.map((w) => w.userId).sort()).toEqual([owner.userId, member.userId].sort());
      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).toContain(member.userId);
    });

    it('unsubscribes the caller', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);

      const res = await owner.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).watch.delete();

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.data).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('keeps an unsubscription when the member acts on the issue again', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);
      await owner.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).watch.delete();

      await owner.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).comments.post({ body: 'still here' });

      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('subscribes again after an unsubscription', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);
      await owner.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).watch.delete();

      await owner.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).watch.post();

      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).toEqual([owner.userId]);
    });

    it('rejects a non-member', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const outsider = await signUpTestUser();
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);

      const res = await authedApi(outsider.cookie).issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).watch.post();

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    });

    it('is a 404 for an issue that does not exist', async () => {
      const { owner } = await setup();

      const res = await owner.api.issues({ issueId: 999999 }).watch.post();

      expect(res.status).toBe(404);
    });
  });

  describe('managing other watchers', () => {
    it('lets an editor add and remove a project member', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);
      const endpoint = owner.api
        .issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id })
        .watchers({ userId: member.userId });

      const added = await endpoint.put();
      expect(added.status).toBe(200);
      expect(added.data!.map((watcher) => watcher.userId)).toContain(member.userId);

      const removed = await endpoint.delete();
      expect(removed.status).toBe(200);
      expect(removed.data!.map((watcher) => watcher.userId)).not.toContain(member.userId);

      // An editor's explicit removal is sticky just like the member's own unwatch.
      await member.api
        .issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id })
        .comments.post({ body: 'still involved' });
      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).not.toContain(member.userId);
    });

    it('rejects a user outside the project', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const outsider = await signUpTestUser();
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);

      const res = await owner.api
        .issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id })
        .watchers({ userId: outsider.userId })
        .put();

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).not.toContain(outsider.userId);
    });

    it('rejects an AI agent even though its bot user is a project member', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const agent = await createAgent(owner.api, 'MKT', {
        name: 'Watcher Bot',
        username: 'watcher-bot',
        kind: 'external',
      });
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);
      const agentUserId = agent.data!.agent.userId;

      const res = await owner.api
        .issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id })
        .watchers({ userId: agentUserId })
        .put();

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).not.toContain(agentUserId);
    });

    it('rejects a member who cannot read work items', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const role = await createRole(owner.api, 'MKT', {
        name: 'No work items',
        permissions: {},
      });
      const restricted = await addMember(owner, { roleId: role.data!.id });
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);

      const res = await owner.api
        .issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id })
        .watchers({ userId: restricted.userId })
        .put();

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).not.toContain(restricted.userId);
    });

    it('keeps self-watch available to a reader but denies managing other people', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const role = await createRole(owner.api, 'MKT', {
        name: 'Reader',
        permissions: {
          work_items: { create: false, edit: false, read: true, delete: false },
        },
      });
      const reader = await addMember(owner, { roleId: role.data!.id });
      const target = await addMember(owner);
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);

      const selfWatch = await reader.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).watch.post();
      expect(selfWatch.status).toBe(200);
      expect(selfWatch.data!.map((watcher) => watcher.userId)).toContain(reader.userId);

      const manage = await reader.api
        .issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id })
        .watchers({ userId: target.userId })
        .put();
      expect(manage.status).toBe(403);
      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).not.toContain(target.userId);
    });
  });

  describe('notifications', () => {
    it('notifies a watcher of a status change, and stops once they unwatch', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const view = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).get();
      const columns = view.data!.columns;
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);
      const issueId = issue.data!.id;
      await member.api.issues({ issueId }).watch.post();

      await owner.api.issues({ issueId }).patch({ columnId: columns[1].id });
      const first = await member.api.notifications.get({ query: { types: 'state_changed' } });
      expect(first.data!.items).toHaveLength(1);

      await member.api.issues({ issueId }).watch.delete();
      await owner.api.issues({ issueId }).patch({ columnId: columns[2].id });

      const after = await member.api.notifications.get({ query: { types: 'state_changed' } });
      expect(after.data!.items).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it('notifies a mentioned member who does not watch the issue', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);
      const issueId = issue.data!.id;
      await member.api.issues({ issueId }).watch.delete();

      await owner.api.issues({ issueId }).comments.post({ body: `@${member.username} look` });

      const inbox = await member.api.notifications.get({ query: { types: 'mentioned' } });
      expect(inbox.data!.items).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it('stops exposing watcher events after work-item read access is revoked', async () => {
      const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const view = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).get();
      const issue = await createIssue(owner.api, columnId);
      await member.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).watch.post();
      const blockedRole = await createRole(owner.api, 'MKT', {
        name: 'No issue access',
        permissions: {},
      });

      await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'member', roleId: blockedRole.data!.id });
      await owner.api.issues({ issueId: issue.data!.id }).patch({
        columnId: view.data!.columns[1].id,
      });

      expect(await watcherIds(owner.api, issue.data!.id)).not.toContain(member.userId);
      const inbox = await member.api.notifications.get({ query: { types: 'state_changed' } });
      expect(inbox.data!.items).toHaveLength(0);
    });
  });
});

FILE: apps/api/src/modules/issues/__tests__/integration/worklogs.test.ts
