      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      const row = list.data?.items.find((m) => m.userId === member.user.userId);
      expect(row).toMatchObject({ role: 'owner', roleId: null, roleName: null });
    });

    it('demotes an owner to a member role when another owner remains', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const other = await addMember(owner, 'owner');
      const roleId = await makeRole(owner);

      const res = await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: other.user.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'member', roleId });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);

      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      const row = list.data?.items.find((m) => m.userId === other.user.userId);
      expect(row).toMatchObject({ role: 'member', roleId, roleName: 'Editor' });
    });

    it('refuses to change your own role with 400', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const roleId = await makeRole(owner);

      const res = await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: owner.user.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'member', roleId });
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);

      // The owner is unchanged.
      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      const row = list.data?.items.find((m) => m.userId === owner.user.userId);
      expect(row).toMatchObject({ role: 'owner' });
    });

    it('returns 400 when the role belongs to another team', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      // Every project of a team shares its roles, so only a role of another team is
      // out of reach here.
      const stranger = await setupOwner2();
      const foreign = await createRole(stranger.api, 'OPS', { name: 'Ops', permissions: {} });

      const res = await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'member', roleId: foreign.data!.id });
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    });

    it('returns 400 when role is missing from the body', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);

      const res = await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        // @ts-expect-error — role is required
        .patch({ roleId: null });
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    });

    it('denies a non-owner member with 403', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const other = await addMember(owner);
      const roleId = await makeRole(owner);

      const res = await member.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: other.user.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'member', roleId });
      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    });

    it('lets a manager of the team assign a role without being in the project', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const manager = await addTeamMember(owner, 'manager');
      const roleId = await makeRole(owner);

      const res = await authedApi(manager.cookie)
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'member', roleId });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);

      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      expect(list.data?.items.find((m) => m.userId === member.user.userId)).toMatchObject({
        roleId,
      });
    });

    it('lets a member whose role grants members_manage edit assign a role', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const editor = await addMember(owner);
      const other = await addMember(owner);
      const role = await createRole(owner.api, 'MKT', {
        name: 'People',
        permissions: { members_manage: { read: true, edit: true } },
      });
      await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: editor.user.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'member', roleId: role.data!.id });

      const res = await editor.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: other.user.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'member', roleId: role.data!.id });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);
    });

    it('denies a member whose role grants members_manage edit the owner role with 403', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const editor = await addMember(owner);
      const other = await addMember(owner);
      const role = await createRole(owner.api, 'MKT', {
        name: 'People',
        permissions: { members_manage: { read: true, edit: true } },
      });
      await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: editor.user.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'member', roleId: role.data!.id });

      const res = await editor.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: other.user.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'owner' });
      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    });

    it('lets a manager of the team promote a member to owner', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const manager = await addTeamMember(owner, 'manager');

      const res = await authedApi(manager.cookie)
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'owner' });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);
    });

    it('denies a non-member with 403', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const outsider = authedApi((await signUpTestUser()).cookie);

      const res = await outsider
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .patch({ role: 'member', roleId: null });
      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    });
  });

  describe('description — PATCH /projects/:projectKey/members/:userId/description', () => {
    it("defaults a member's description to empty", async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();

      const res = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      expect(res.data?.items[0]).toMatchObject({ description: '' });
    });

    it("lets an owner set a member's description", async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);

      const res = await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .description.patch({ description: 'Backend engineer' });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);

      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      const row = list.data?.items.find((m) => m.userId === member.user.userId);
      expect(row).toMatchObject({ description: 'Backend engineer' });
    });

    it('clears a description with an empty string', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .description.patch({ description: 'QA' });

      const res = await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .description.patch({ description: '' });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);

      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      const row = list.data?.items.find((m) => m.userId === member.user.userId);
      expect(row).toMatchObject({ description: '' });
    });

    it('404s for a non-member userId', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const stranger = await signUpTestUser();

      const res = await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: stranger.userId })
        .description.patch({ description: 'x' });
      expect(res.status).toBe(404);
    });

    it('lets a member set their own description', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);

      const res = await member.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .description.patch({ description: 'I do the docs' });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);

      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      const row = list.data?.items.find((m) => m.userId === member.user.userId);
      expect(row).toMatchObject({ description: 'I do the docs' });
    });

    it("lets a manager of the team set a member's description without being in the project", async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const manager = await addTeamMember(owner, 'manager');

      const res = await authedApi(manager.cookie)
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .description.patch({ description: 'Runs the launch' });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);

      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      expect(list.data?.items.find((m) => m.userId === member.user.userId)).toMatchObject({
        description: 'Runs the launch',
      });
    });

    it("denies a member editing another member's description with 403", async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const other = await addMember(owner);

      const res = await member.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: other.user.userId })
        .description.patch({ description: 'not yours' });
      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    });
  });

  describe('remove — DELETE /projects/:projectKey/members/:userId', () => {
    it('lets an owner remove a member, revoking their access', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);

      const res = await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .delete();
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);

      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      expect(list.data?.items.map((m) => m.userId)).toEqual([owner.user.userId]);

      // The removed member can no longer reach the project.
      const gone = await member.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).get();
      expect(gone.status).toBe(403);
    });

    it('lets a member remove themselves (leave the project)', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);

      const res = await member.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .delete();
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);

      const gone = await member.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).get();
      expect(gone.status).toBe(403);
    });

    it('denies a member removing another member with 403', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const a = await addMember(owner);
      const b = await addMember(owner);

      const res = await a.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: b.user.userId })
        .delete();
      expect(res.status).toBe(403);

      // b is still a member.
      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      expect(list.data?.items.map((m) => m.userId)).toContain(b.user.userId);
    });

    it('returns 404 when the userId is not a member', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const stranger = await signUpTestUser();

      const res = await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: stranger.userId })
        .delete();
      expect(res.status).toBe(404);
    });

    it('refuses to remove the last owner with 400', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();

      const res = await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: owner.user.userId })
        .delete();
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);

      // The owner is still a member.
      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      expect(list.data?.items.map((m) => m.userId)).toContain(owner.user.userId);
    });

    it('lets an owner leave when another owner remains', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      await addMember(owner, 'owner');

      const res = await owner.api
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: owner.user.userId })
        .delete();
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);
    });

    it('lets a manager of the team remove a member without being in the project', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const manager = await addTeamMember(owner, 'manager');

      const res = await authedApi(manager.cookie)
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .delete();
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);

      const list = await owner.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).members.get();
      expect(list.data?.items.map((m) => m.userId)).toEqual([owner.user.userId]);
    });

    it('denies a non-member with 403', async () => {
      const owner = await setupOwner();
      const member = await addMember(owner);
      const outsider = authedApi((await signUpTestUser()).cookie);

      const res = await outsider
        .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
        .members({ userId: member.user.userId })
        .delete();
      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    });
  });
});

FILE: apps/api/src/modules/members/__tests__/integration/role-escalation.test.ts

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'bun:test';
import { db, teamInvite } from '@repo/db';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { authedApi, createProject } from '#tests/helpers/app';
import { createRole, listProjectRoles } from '#tests/helpers/roles';
import { addProjectMember } from '#tests/helpers/members';
import { signUpTestUser } from '#tests/helpers/auth';
import { resetDb } from '#tests/helpers/db';

// Two escalation paths the member permission must not open: a non-owner must not be
// able to unseat an owner, and assigning a role must not grant permissions beyond the
// granter's own.
async function setup() {
  const owner = await signUpTestUser({ name: 'Owner' });
  const asOwner = authedApi(owner.cookie);
  const created = await createProject(asOwner, { key: 'MKT', name: 'Marketing' });
  expect(created.status).toBe(201);
  return { asOwner };
}

// A handler: can manage members and invite, but holds no ai_agents permission.
function handlerPermissions() {
  return {
    members_manage: { read: true, create: true, edit: true, delete: true },
    members_invite: { read: true, create: true },
  };
}

const project = (api: ReturnType<typeof authedApi>) => api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' });

describe('role escalation guards', () => {
  beforeEach(resetDb);

  it('lets only an owner demote or expel another owner', async () => {
    const { asOwner } = await setup();
    const roleId = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', { name: 'Handler', permissions: handlerPermissions() })
    ).data!.id;
    const asHandler = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT', roleId);

    // A second person joins, then the real owner promotes them to owner.
    const victim = await signUpTestUser({ team: false });
    const asVictim = authedApi(victim.cookie);
    const invite = await project(asOwner).invites.post({ email: victim.email, role: 'member' });
    await asVictim.invites({ token: invite.data!.token }).accept.post();
    await project(asOwner).members({ userId: victim.userId }).patch({ role: 'owner' });

    // The handler cannot demote or expel the owner.
    expect(
      (await project(asHandler).members({ userId: victim.userId }).patch({ role: 'member' }))
        .status,
    ).toBe(403);
    expect((await project(asHandler).members({ userId: victim.userId }).delete()).status).toBe(403);

    // The owner can.
    expect((await project(asOwner).members({ userId: victim.userId }).delete()).status).toBe(204);
  });

  it('refuses to invite with a role more powerful than the granter', async () => {
    const { asOwner } = await setup();
    const handler = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', { name: 'Handler', permissions: handlerPermissions() })
    ).data!.id;
    const powerful = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', {
        name: 'Powerful',
        permissions: { ...handlerPermissions(), ai_agents: { read: true, edit: true } },
      })
    ).data!.id;
    const asHandler = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT', handler);

    // The handler lacks ai_agents, so it cannot hand out a role that has it.
    expect(
      (
        await project(asHandler).invites.post({
          email: 'new-1@example.com',
          role: 'member',
          roleId: powerful,
        })
      ).status,
    ).toBe(403);

    // A role within its own permissions is fine.
    expect(
      (
        await project(asHandler).invites.post({
          email: 'new-2@example.com',
          role: 'member',
          roleId: handler,
        })
      ).status,
    ).toBe(201);
  });

  it('hides the link of an invite whose role is more powerful than the viewer', async () => {
    const { asOwner } = await setup();
    const handler = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', { name: 'Handler', permissions: handlerPermissions() })
    ).data!.id;
    const powerful = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', {
        name: 'Powerful',
        permissions: { ...handlerPermissions(), ai_agents: { read: true, edit: true } },
      })
    ).data!.id;
    const asHandler = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT', handler);
    await project(asOwner).invites.post({
      email: 'strong@example.com',
      role: 'member',
      roleId: powerful,
    });
    await project(asOwner).invites.post({
      email: 'peer@example.com',
      role: 'member',
      roleId: handler,
    });

    const tokens = async (api: ReturnType<typeof authedApi>) =>
      Object.fromEntries(
        ((await project(api).invites.get()).data ?? []).map((i) => [i.email, i.token]),
      );
    const asSeenByHandler = await tokens(asHandler);
    expect(asSeenByHandler['strong@example.com']).toBeNull();
    expect(asSeenByHandler['peer@example.com']).toBeString();
    expect((await tokens(asOwner))['strong@example.com']).toBeString();
  });

  it('refuses to renew an invite with a role more powerful than the renewer', async () => {
    const { asOwner } = await setup();
    const handler = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', { name: 'Handler', permissions: handlerPermissions() })
    ).data!.id;
    const powerful = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', {
        name: 'Powerful',
        permissions: { ...handlerPermissions(), ai_agents: { read: true, edit: true } },
      })
    ).data!.id;
    const asHandler = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT', handler);

    const invite = await project(asOwner).invites.post({
      email: 'new-1@example.com',
      role: 'member',
      roleId: powerful,
    });
    await db
      .update(teamInvite)
      .set({ createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 8 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) })
      .where(eq(teamInvite.token, invite.data!.token));

    expect(
      (await project(asHandler).invites({ inviteId: invite.data!.id }).renew.post()).status,
    ).toBe(403);
    expect(
      (await project(asOwner).invites({ inviteId: invite.data!.id }).renew.post()).status,
    ).toBe(201);
  });

  it('refuses to add or move a member to a role more powerful than the granter', async () => {
    const { asOwner } = await setup();
    const handler = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', { name: 'Handler', permissions: handlerPermissions() })
    ).data!.id;
    const powerful = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', {
        name: 'Powerful',
        permissions: { ...handlerPermissions(), ai_agents: { read: true, edit: true } },
      })
    ).data!.id;
    const asHandler = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT', handler);

    // Someone in the team but not in the project yet.
    const projects = await asOwner.projects.get();
    const teamId = projects.data!.find((p) => p.key === 'MKT')!.teamId;
    const newcomer = await signUpTestUser({ team: false });
    const teamInvite = await asOwner
      .teams({ teamId })
      .invites.post({ email: newcomer.email, role: 'member' });
    await authedApi(newcomer.cookie).invites({ token: teamInvite.data!.token }).accept.post();

    expect(
      (
        await project(asHandler).members.post({
          userId: newcomer.userId,
          role: 'member',
          roleId: powerful,
        })
      ).status,
    ).toBe(403);
    expect(
      (
        await project(asHandler).members.post({
          userId: newcomer.userId,
          role: 'member',
          roleId: handler,
        })
      ).status,
    ).toBe(204);

    expect(
      (
        await project(asHandler)
          .members({ userId: newcomer.userId })
          .patch({ role: 'member', roleId: powerful })
      ).status,
    ).toBe(403);
  });

  it('holds the default role to the same cap when roleId is omitted', async () => {
    const { asOwner } = await setup();
    const handler = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', { name: 'Handler', permissions: handlerPermissions() })
    ).data!.id;
    const asHandler = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT', handler);
    const viewer = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', {
        name: 'Viewer',
        permissions: { work_items: { read: true } },
      })
    ).data!.id;

    // The handler holds no work_items permission, which the default role grants.
    expect(
      (await project(asHandler).invites.post({ email: 'new-1@example.com', role: 'member' }))
        .status,
    ).toBe(403);

    const projects = await asOwner.projects.get();
    const teamId = projects.data!.find((p) => p.key === 'MKT')!.teamId;
    const newcomer = await signUpTestUser({ team: false });
    const joined = await asOwner
      .teams({ teamId })
      .invites.post({ email: newcomer.email, role: 'member' });
    await authedApi(newcomer.cookie).invites({ token: joined.data!.token }).accept.post();
    expect(
      (await project(asHandler).members.post({ userId: newcomer.userId, role: 'member' })).status,
    ).toBe(403);
    await project(asOwner).members.post({
      userId: newcomer.userId,
      role: 'member',
      roleId: viewer,
    });
    expect(
      (
        await project(asHandler)
          .members({ userId: newcomer.userId })
          .patch({ role: 'member', roleId: null })
      ).status,
    ).toBe(403);

    // An invite on the default role: its link is hidden from the handler, who cannot renew it.
    const invite = await project(asOwner).invites.post({
      email: 'new-2@example.com',
      role: 'member',
    });
    const seen = (await project(asHandler).invites.get()).data!;
    expect(seen.find((i) => i.email === 'new-2@example.com')!.token).toBeNull();
    await db
      .update(teamInvite)
      .set({ createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 8 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) })
      .where(eq(teamInvite.token, invite.data!.token));
    expect(
      (await project(asHandler).invites({ inviteId: invite.data!.id }).renew.post()).status,
    ).toBe(403);
  });

  it("lets a granter who holds the default role's permissions omit roleId", async () => {
    const { asOwner } = await setup();
    const defaultRole = (await listProjectRoles(asOwner, 'MKT')).data!.find((r) => r.isDefault)!;
    const lead = (
      await createRole(asOwner, 'MKT', {
        name: 'Lead',
        permissions: { ...defaultRole.permissions, ...handlerPermissions() },
      })
    ).data!.id;
    const asLead = await addProjectMember(asOwner, 'MKT', lead);

    expect(
      (await project(asLead).invites.post({ email: 'new-1@example.com', role: 'member' })).status,
    ).toBe(201);
  });
});

// Inbox: the session user's own notifications across every project they are a
// member of. Every route is scoped to that user (no project permission needed to
// read your own inbox); single-notification actions only touch a row that belongs
// to the user.
export const notificationRoutes = new Elysia({
  name: 'notifications',
  detail: { tags: ['Notifications'] },
})
  .use(authContext)

  .get(
    '/notifications',
    async ({ user, query, request }) => {
      const userId = requireUser(user).id;
      const limit = query.limit != null ? Number(query.limit) : 30;
      let before = null;
      if (query.cursor) {
        try {
          before = JSON.parse(query.cursor);
        } catch {
          // Ignore a malformed cursor and serve the first page.
        }
      }
      const filters: NotificationFilters = {};
      if (query.types) {
        const types = query.types
          .split(',')
          .filter((x): x is NotificationType =>
            (NOTIFICATION_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(x),
          );
        if (types.length) filters.types = types;
      }
      if (query.from) filters.fromUserId = query.from;
      if (query.projectId) filters.projectId = Number(query.projectId);
      filters.includeRead = query.includeRead !== 'false';
      filters.includeSnoozed = query.includeSnoozed === 'true';
      filters.mcpOnly = isMcpRequest(request.headers);
      return listNotifications(userId, { before, limit, filters });
    },
    {
      query: listNotificationsQuery,
      response: { 200: NotificationPageResponse, ...errors(401) },
      detail: {
        summary: 'List inbox notifications',
        description: 'List your inbox notifications, newest first.',
        ...mcpTool('list_notifications'),
      },
    },
  )

  // The badge count. Refetched when the inbox scope of GET /sync/rev moves.
  .get(
    '/notifications/unread',
    async ({ user, query, request }) => {
      const userId = requireUser(user).id;
      const projectId = query.projectId ? Number(query.projectId) : undefined;
      return { unread: await unreadCount(userId, projectId, isMcpRequest(request.headers)) };
    },
    {
      query: unreadCountQuery,
      response: { 200: UnreadCountResponse, ...errors(401) },
      detail: {
        summary: 'Get unread notification count',
        description: 'Count your unread inbox notifications, in all projects or one.',
        ...mcpTool('get_unread_notification_count'),
      },
    },
  )

  .post(
    '/notifications/read-all',
    async ({ user, body, request }) => {
      const userId = requireUser(user).id;
      const count = await markAllRead(userId, body?.projectId, {
        types: body?.types,
        fromUserId: body?.from,
        includeRead: body?.includeRead,
        includeSnoozed: body?.includeSnoozed ?? true,
        mcpOnly: isMcpRequest(request.headers),
      });
      return { count };
    },
    {
      body: markAllReadBody,
      response: { 200: AffectedCountResponse, ...errors(401) },
      detail: {
        summary: 'Mark all notifications read',
        description:
          'Mark your unread inbox notifications as read, in ' +
          'all projects or one. Returns the number changed.',
        ...mcpTool('mark_all_notifications_read'),
      },
    },
  )

  .delete(
    '/notifications',
    async ({ user, query }) => {
      const userId = requireUser(user).id;
      const scope = (query.scope ?? 'read') as DeleteScope;
      const projectId = query.projectId ? Number(query.projectId) : undefined;
      let types: NotificationType[] | undefined;
      if (query.types != null) {
        const supplied = query.types.split(',');
        if (supplied.some((value) => !(NOTIFICATION_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(value)))
          throw new HttpError(400, 'Invalid notification type');
        types = supplied as NotificationType[];
      }
      const count = await deleteNotifications(userId, scope, projectId, {
        types,
        fromUserId: query.from,
        includeRead: query.includeRead !== 'false',
        includeSnoozed: query.includeSnoozed !== 'false',
      });
      return { count };
    },
    {
      query: deleteNotificationsQuery,
      response: { 200: AffectedCountResponse, ...errors(400, 401) },
      detail: {
        summary: 'Delete inbox notifications',
        description:
          'Delete the caller’s notifications by scope. completed includes read and unread ' +
          'notifications on completed or canceled issues; read-completed keeps only read ones. ' +
          'The type, actor and snooze filters narrow either scope.',
      },
    },
  )

  .post(
    '/notifications/:id/read',
    async ({ user, params, body, request }) => {
      const userId = requireUser(user).id;
      const read = body?.read ?? true;
      const ok = await setNotificationRead(userId, params.id, read, isMcpRequest(request.headers));
      if (!ok) throw new HttpError(404, 'Notification not found');
      return noContent();
    },
    {
      params: notificationParams,
      body: setNotificationReadBody,
      response: { 204: t.Void(), ...errors(401, 404) },
      detail: {
        summary: 'Mark a notification read or unread',
        description: 'Mark one of your inbox notifications as read, or as unread with read false.',
        ...mcpTool('mark_notification_read'),
      },
    },
  )

  .post(
    '/notifications/:id/snooze',
    async ({ user, params, body }) => {
      const userId = requireUser(user).id;
      const until = body.until ? new Date(body.until) : null;
      if (until && Number.isNaN(until.getTime())) throw new HttpError(400, 'Invalid snooze time');
      const ok = await snoozeNotification(userId, params.id, until);
      if (!ok) throw new HttpError(404, 'Notification not found');
      return noContent();
    },
    {
      params: notificationParams,
      body: snoozeNotificationBody,
      response: { 204: t.Void(), ...errors(400, 401, 404) },
      detail: {
        summary: 'Snooze a notification',
        description: 'Snooze a notification until a time, or clear its snooze.',
      },
    },
  )

  .delete(
    '/notifications/:id',
    async ({ user, params }) => {
      const userId = requireUser(user).id;
      const ok = await deleteNotification(userId, params.id);
      if (!ok) throw new HttpError(404, 'Notification not found');
      return noContent();
    },
    {
      params: notificationParams,
      response: { 204: t.Void(), ...errors(401, 404) },
      detail: { summary: 'Delete a notification' },
    },
  );

import {
  db,
  notificationDelivery,
  issue,
  issueActivity,
  project,
  projectDocument,
  team,
  user,
  emailSource,
  getProjectEmailConfig,
  getWebPushConfig,
  type DeliveryPayload,
} from '@repo/db';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { composeEmail, isAccountDeactivated, savedLocales } from '@repo/auth';
import { DEFAULT_LOCALE, emailWords, type CoreEmailKey, type Locale } from '@repo/mailer';
import { readRedactedSettings } from '#modules/notification-settings/service';
import { getPreferencesForUsers } from '#modules/notification-preferences/service';
import { getTelegramChatIds, hasUsableInstanceBot } from '#modules/telegram/service';
import { getPushSubscriptionIds } from '#modules/push/service';
import { escapeHtml } from '#shared/lib';
import { commentUrl, documentUrl, issueUrl, teamRef } from '#modules/teams/ref';
import type { NotificationType, NewNotificationRow } from './service';

// Outbound notification delivery: turns the inbox notification rows produced by an
// issue or document event into notification_delivery outbox rows. Delivery is per
// member and per their own preferences: for each inbox row (already one per
// recipient), the member's notification-preferences decide whether it goes by email
// (to their account address), Telegram (to the chat of the Telegram account they
// linked) and/or Web Push (one row for each browser they subscribed). The team that
// owns the project supplies the provider credentials (SMTP/Resend, and optionally its
// own bot token — Telegram otherwise goes through the instance bot); push is on for
// the whole instance while its VAPID keys are set. The message text is composed here
// at enqueue time and stored on the row; the worker drains the outbox and the sender
// reads the credentials at send time.
//
// This is best-effort: enqueue never throws into the caller (a failure here must not
// break creating a comment or updating an issue), so callers wrap it in try/catch.

interface OutboxRow {
  projectId: number;
  channel: 'email' | 'telegram' | 'push';
  recipient: string;
  payload: DeliveryPayload;
}

// The rows outbound delivery is given: inserted already, so the push tag can name them.
type InsertedNotification = NewNotificationRow & { id: number };

// The issue reference shown in messages, e.g. "IAP-42".
function issueRef(projectKey: string, seq: number): string {
  return `${projectKey}-${seq}`;
}

interface StateChange {
  from: string;
  to: string;
}

async function readStateChange(activityId: number): Promise<StateChange | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ payload: issueActivity.payload })
    .from(issueActivity)
    .where(eq(issueActivity.id, activityId));
  const from = row?.payload.from?.value;
  const to = row?.payload.to?.value;
  if (!from || !to) return null;
  return { from, to };
}

const EMAIL_TEMPLATE: Record<NotificationType, CoreEmailKey> = {
  assigned: 'assigned',
  mentioned: 'mentioned',
  commented: 'commented',
  state_changed: 'stateChanged',
  reacted: 'reacted',
};

// What happened, as the Telegram message and the push notification say it.
// Issue-centric third person, matching the email copy without repeating the
// second-person address.
function eventAction(
  type: NotificationType,
  actor: string,
  stateChange: StateChange | null,
  emoji: string,
): string {
  switch (type) {
    case 'assigned':
      return `Assigned by ${actor}`;
    case 'mentioned':
      return `Mentioned by ${actor}`;
    case 'commented':
      return `New comment by ${actor}`;
    case 'state_changed':
      return stateChange
        ? `Status changed from ${stateChange.from} to ${stateChange.to} by ${actor}`
        : `Status changed by ${actor}`;
    case 'reacted':
      return `${actor} reacted to your comment with ${emoji}`;
  }
}

const TELEGRAM_EMOJI: Record<NotificationType, string> = {
  assigned: '📌',
  mentioned: '💬',
  commented: '💬',
  state_changed: '🔄',
  reacted: '🙂',
};

// Telegram copy. Rendered as HTML (parse_mode HTML) with the issue reference as a
// clickable link, plus a plain-text fallback.
function telegramPayload(
  type: NotificationType,
  ref: string,
  title: string,
  action: string,
  url: string | undefined,
): DeliveryPayload {
  const emoji = TELEGRAM_EMOJI[type];

  // HTML (parse_mode=HTML): the issue reference is the clickable link, so no raw URL
  // is shown. A blank line (\n\n) separates the title line from the action line. The
  // plain-text fallback carries no URL here; the sender appends it once.
  const refLink = url
    ? `<a href="${escapeHtml(url)}"><b>${escapeHtml(ref)}</b></a>`
    : `<b>${escapeHtml(ref)}</b>`;
  const html = `${emoji} ${refLink} ${escapeHtml(title)}\n\n<i>${escapeHtml(action)}</i>`;
  const text = `${emoji} ${ref} ${title}\n\n${action}`;
  return { text, html, url };
}

// A document only sends 'mentioned'. The title is the link in Telegram, as the issue
// reference is.
function documentTelegramPayload(
  title: string,
  action: string,
  url: string | undefined,
): DeliveryPayload {
  const titleLink = url
    ? `<a href="${escapeHtml(url)}"><b>${escapeHtml(title)}</b></a>`
    : `<b>${escapeHtml(title)}</b>`;
  return {
    text: `💬 ${title}\n\n${action}`,
    html: `💬 ${titleLink}\n\n<i>${escapeHtml(action)}</i>`,
    url,
  };
}

// Push copy: the issue or the document as the title, what happened as the body. The tag
// names the inbox item as the in-page desktop notification's tag does, so a second push
// for the same item replaces the first.
function pushPayload(
  title: string,
  action: string,
  url: string | undefined,
  notificationId: number,
): DeliveryPayload {
  return { title, text: action, url, tag: `inbox-${notificationId}` };
}

interface Messages {
  email: (type: NotificationType, locale: Locale) => Promise<DeliveryPayload>;
  telegram: (type: NotificationType) => DeliveryPayload;
  push: (type: NotificationType, notificationId: number) => DeliveryPayload;
}

// The copy of one event, about the issue or the document its rows point at. Null when
// that is gone. A comment's event links to the comment.
async function composeMessages(
  notifications: InsertedNotification[],
  projectRow: { key: string; teamId: number; teamSlug: string | null },
  actorName: string | null,
  commentId: number | null,
): Promise<Messages | null> {
  const actor = actorName ?? 'Someone';
  const first = notifications[0];
  const ref = teamRef({ id: projectRow.teamId, slug: projectRow.teamSlug });
  if (first.documentId != null) {
    const documentId = first.documentId;
    const [documentRow] = await db
      .select({ title: projectDocument.title })
      .from(projectDocument)
      .where(eq(projectDocument.id, documentId));
    if (!documentRow) return null;
    const title = documentRow.title.trim();
    const url = documentUrl(ref, projectRow.key, documentId);
    const template =
      first.documentCommentId != null ? 'documentCommentMentioned' : 'documentMentioned';
    const action = eventAction('mentioned', actor, null, '');
    return {
      email: async (_type, locale) => {
        const words = emailWords(locale);
        const vars = { actor: actorName ?? words.someone, document: title || words.untitled };
        return { ...(await composeEmail(template, locale, vars, url)), url };
      },
      telegram: () => documentTelegramPayload(title || 'Untitled', action, url),
      push: (_type, notificationId) =>
        pushPayload(title || 'Untitled', action, url, notificationId),
    };
  }
  if (first.issueId == null) return null;
  const [issueRow] = await db
    .select({ seq: issue.sequenceNumber, title: issue.title })
    .from(issue)
    .where(eq(issue.id, first.issueId));
  if (!issueRow) return null;
  const issueKey = issueRef(projectRow.key, issueRow.seq);
  const url =
    commentId != null
      ? commentUrl(ref, projectRow.key, issueRow.seq, commentId)
      : issueUrl(ref, projectRow.key, issueRow.seq);
  // One issue event, so every 'state_changed' row points at the same activity row.
  const statusActivityId =
    notifications.find((n) => n.type === 'state_changed')?.sourceActivityId ?? null;
  const stateChange = statusActivityId != null ? await readStateChange(statusActivityId) : null;
  // A reaction is one event with one row.
  const emoji = first.reactionEmoji ?? '';
  return {
    email: async (type, locale) => {
      const vars = {
        actor: actorName ?? emailWords(locale).someone,
        ref: issueKey,
        title: issueRow.title,
        from: stateChange?.from ?? '—',
        to: stateChange?.to ?? '—',
        emoji,
      };
      return { ...(await composeEmail(EMAIL_TEMPLATE[type], locale, vars, url)), url };
    },
    telegram: (type) =>
      telegramPayload(
        type,
        issueKey,
        issueRow.title,
        eventAction(type, actor, stateChange, emoji),
        url,
      ),
    push: (type, notificationId) =>
      pushPayload(
        `${issueKey} ${issueRow.title}`,
        eventAction(type, actor, stateChange, emoji),
        url,
        notificationId,
      ),
  };
}

// Enqueues outbound delivery rows for the inbox notifications just created for one
// event. All rows in `notifications` share the same issue or document and actor (every
// call site operates on one of them). No-op when no channel is enabled or no member
// wants any of the event types present.
export async function enqueueOutbound(
  notifications: InsertedNotification[],
  actorName: string | null,
  commentId: number | null,
): Promise<void> {
  if (notifications.length === 0) return;
  const projectId = notifications[0].projectId;

  const [projectRow] = await db
    .select({ key: project.key, name: project.name, teamId: project.teamId, teamSlug: team.slug })
    .from(project)
    .innerJoin(team, eq(team.id, project.teamId))
    .where(eq(project.id, projectId));
  if (!projectRow) return;

  const settings = await readRedactedSettings(projectRow.teamId);

  // The team's own provider when it configured one, otherwise the instance
  // provider when the team asked for it and the instance shares it.
  const source = emailSource(settings);
  const emailEnabled =
    source === 'smtp'
      ? settings.smtp.host.length > 0 && settings.smtp.hasPassword
      : source === 'resend'
        ? settings.resend.hasApiKey
        : source === 'system'
          ? (await getProjectEmailConfig()) !== null
          : false;
  // The team turns Telegram on; the bot that sends is either its own or, when it
  // set no token, the instance bot.
  const telegramEnabled =
    settings.telegram.enabled && (settings.telegram.hasBotToken || (await hasUsableInstanceBot()));
  // The instance's VAPID keys; null while push is off.
  const vapid = getWebPushConfig();
  if (!emailEnabled && !telegramEnabled && !vapid) return;

  const messages = await composeMessages(notifications, projectRow, actorName, commentId);
  if (!messages) return;

  const userIds = [...new Set(notifications.map((n) => n.userId))];
  const [users, prefsByUser, chatIdByUser, localeByUser, pushByUser] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({ id: user.id, email: user.email, active: user.active })
      .from(user)
      .where(inArray(user.id, userIds)),
    getPreferencesForUsers(projectId, userIds),
    telegramEnabled ? getTelegramChatIds(userIds) : Promise.resolve(new Map<string, string>()),
    savedLocales(userIds),
    vapid
      ? getPushSubscriptionIds(userIds, vapid.publicKey)
      : Promise.resolve(new Map<string, number[]>()),
  ]);
  // A deactivated account keeps its projects, but nothing from them reaches it.
  const emailById = new Map(
    users.filter((u) => !isAccountDeactivated(u)).map((u) => [u.id, u.email]),
  );

  // Everyone told the same thing in one language gets the same email, composed once.
  const emails = new Map<string, Promise<DeliveryPayload>>();
  const emailFor = (type: NotificationType, locale: Locale) => {
    const key = `${type}:${locale}`;
    const email = emails.get(key) ?? messages.email(type, locale);
    emails.set(key, email);
    return email;
  };

  const out: OutboxRow[] = [];
  for (const n of notifications) {
    const prefs = prefsByUser.get(n.userId);
    const email = emailById.get(n.userId);
    if (!prefs || !email) continue; // not opted in, or deactivated

    if (emailEnabled && prefs.emailEvents[n.type]) {
      out.push({
        projectId,
        channel: 'email',
        recipient: email,
        payload: await emailFor(n.type, localeByUser.get(n.userId) ?? DEFAULT_LOCALE),
      });
    }
    if (telegramEnabled && prefs.telegramEvents[n.type]) {
      // No linked Telegram account means nowhere to send; the member sees the prompt
      // to link one in the project's notification settings.
      const chatId = chatIdByUser.get(n.userId);
      if (chatId) {
        out.push({
          projectId,
          channel: 'telegram',
          recipient: chatId,
          payload: messages.telegram(n.type),
        });
      }
    }
    if (vapid && prefs.pushEvents[n.type]) {
      // One row per browser, so a retry or a failure stays with that browser.
      for (const subscriptionId of pushByUser.get(n.userId) ?? []) {
        out.push({
          projectId,
          channel: 'push',
          recipient: String(subscriptionId),
          payload: messages.push(n.type, n.id),
        });
      }
    }
  }

  if (out.length === 0) return;
  await db.insert(notificationDelivery).values(out);
}

import {
  db,
  notification,
  projectMember,
  user,
  issue,
  issueActivity,
  project,
  team,
  projectColumn,
  projectDocument,
  type ActivityPayload,
} from '@repo/db';
import { and, desc, eq, inArray, isNotNull, lt, or, sql, isNull } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { addedMentionHandles, resolveMentionHandles, type MentionedUsers } from '#shared/mentions';
import { autoWatchIssue, isEligibleIssueWatcher, watcherUserIds } from '#modules/issues/watchers';
import { mentionReach } from '#modules/mentions/service';
import { iso } from '#shared/lib';
import { enqueueOutbound } from './outbound';
import { documentVisibleTo } from '#modules/documents/access';

// Inbox notifications. A notification is one (recipient, event) row: a user is told
// about an issue they are involved in, or that a document mentions them. What happens
// on the issue ('commented', 'state_changed') goes to its watchers (issue_watcher, see
// modules/issues/watchers.ts); what is addressed to one person ('assigned',
// 'mentioned') goes to them whether they watch the issue or not, and subscribes them
// to it. A reaction to a comment ('reacted') goes to the comment's author alone. A
// document has no watchers, so it only sends 'mentioned'. The actor is never
// notified about their own action, and only project members receive notifications,
// so agent bot users (assigned via delegate, not members) are excluded.

export const NOTIFICATION_TYPES = [
  'assigned',
  'mentioned',
  'commented',
  'state_changed',
  'reacted',
] as const;
export type NotificationType = (typeof NOTIFICATION_TYPES)[number];

// Points at an issue, or at a document: then documentId is set and issueId is null.
export interface NewNotificationRow {
  userId: string;
  projectId: number;
  issueId: number | null;
  sourceActivityId: number | null;
  documentId?: number;
  documentCommentId?: string | null;
  type: NotificationType;
  actorUserId: string | null;
  // The emoji of a 'reacted' row.
  reactionEmoji?: string;
}

// Keeps only the ids that are members of the project. Filters out non-members (an
// agent's bot user is assigned via delegate but is not a member) and users who have
// lost access.
async function keepProjectMembers(projectId: number, ids: string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (ids.length === 0) return new Set();
  const rows = await db
    .select({ userId: projectMember.userId })
    .from(projectMember)
    .where(and(eq(projectMember.projectId, projectId), inArray(projectMember.userId, ids)));
  return new Set(rows.map((r) => r.userId));
}

async function actorName(id: string | null): Promise<string | null> {
  if (id == null) return null;
  const rows = await db.select({ name: user.name }).from(user).where(eq(user.id, id));
  return rows[0]?.name ?? null;
}

// commentId names the comment the event is about, which its email and Telegram link to.
async function insertNotifications(
  rows: NewNotificationRow[],
  commentId: number | null = null,
): Promise<void> {
  if (rows.length === 0) return;
  const name = await actorName(rows[0].actorUserId);
  // Postgres returns the rows of a multi-row VALUES insert in the order of its VALUES.
  const inserted = await db
    .insert(notification)
    .values(rows.map((r) => ({ ...r, actorName: name })))
    .returning({ id: notification.id });
  // Fan out to the project's enabled delivery channels (email, Telegram, push).
  // Best-effort: a delivery failure must not break the inbox insert or the domain mutation.
  try {
    await enqueueOutbound(
      rows.map((r, i) => ({ ...r, id: inserted[i]!.id })),
      name,
      commentId,
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[notifications] outbound enqueue failed:', err);
  }
}

// Fan out a new comment. Mentioned members get a 'mentioned' notification; the
// watchers get 'commented'. A mentioned user gets only the 'mentioned' one. The
// comment author is never notified. Commenting and being mentioned both subscribe
// to the issue, so the watchers are resolved after that.
export async function notifyComment(
  projectId: number,
  comment: { issueId: number; id: number; actorUserId: string | null; body: string | null },
  mentionedUsers: MentionedUsers,
): Promise<void> {
  const actor = comment.actorUserId;
  const mentioned = new Set([...mentionedUsers.memberIds, ...mentionedUsers.agentUserIds]);
  await autoWatchIssue(projectId, comment.issueId, [actor, ...mentioned]);
  const watchers = await watcherUserIds(projectId, comment.issueId);

  const rows: NewNotificationRow[] = [];
  for (const userId of mentioned) {
    if (userId === actor) continue;
    rows.push({
      userId,
      projectId,
      issueId: comment.issueId,
      sourceActivityId: comment.id,
      type: 'mentioned',
      actorUserId: actor,
    });
  }
  for (const userId of watchers) {
    if (userId === actor || mentioned.has(userId)) continue;
    rows.push({
      userId,
      projectId,
      issueId: comment.issueId,
      sourceActivityId: comment.id,
      type: 'commented',
      actorUserId: actor,
    });
  }
  await insertNotifications(rows, comment.id);
}

// Tells the author of a comment that a member reacted to it. Nobody is told about a
// reaction to their own comment, and the author is skipped unless they are a person
// who can still read the project's issues (not an agent, not a member who left). A
// member's reactions to one comment are told once, with the first emoji: more emoji,
// or one taken back and added again, find that notification and stay quiet, so
// reactions cannot fill an inbox. An author who deleted the notification is told
// again by the next new reaction.
export async function notifyReaction(
  projectId: number,
  comment: { issueId: number; id: number; actorUserId: string | null },
  reactorUserId: string,
  emoji: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const author = comment.actorUserId;
  if (author == null || author === reactorUserId) return;
  if (!(await isEligibleIssueWatcher(projectId, author))) return;
  const [told] = await db
    .select({ id: notification.id })
    .from(notification)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(notification.userId, author),
        eq(notification.type, 'reacted'),
        eq(notification.sourceActivityId, comment.id),
        eq(notification.actorUserId, reactorUserId),
      ),
    )
    .limit(1);
  if (told) return;
  await insertNotifications(
    [
      {
        userId: author,
        projectId,
        issueId: comment.issueId,
        sourceActivityId: comment.id,
        type: 'reacted',
        actorUserId: reactorUserId,
        reactionEmoji: emoji,
      },
    ],
    comment.id,
  );
}

// Fan out the mentions an edit newly added to a comment. The handles the comment
// already named are filtered out by the caller, so an edit never re-pings them, and
// the watchers hear nothing (unlike a new comment, which would send 'commented').
// Being mentioned subscribes to the issue, the same as in a new comment.
export async function notifyEditedCommentMentions(
  projectId: number,
  comment: { issueId: number; id: number; actorUserId: string | null },
  mentionedUsers: MentionedUsers,
): Promise<void> {
  const mentioned = [...mentionedUsers.memberIds, ...mentionedUsers.agentUserIds].filter(
    (userId) => userId !== comment.actorUserId,
  );
  if (mentioned.length === 0) return;
  await autoWatchIssue(projectId, comment.issueId, mentioned);
  await insertNotifications(
    mentioned.map((userId) => ({
      userId,
      projectId,
      issueId: comment.issueId,
      sourceActivityId: comment.id,
      type: 'mentioned' as const,
      actorUserId: comment.actorUserId,
    })),
    comment.id,
  );
}

// Fan out the mentions an issue's description or markdown custom field gained. Only
// the handles the write added are reached, so re-saving a text keeps quiet about the
// people it already named. Being mentioned subscribes to the issue, the same as it
// does in a comment. A text reaches only the members it names (see mentionReach): an
// agent is addressed in a comment, or given an issue by delegation.
export async function notifyTextMentions(input: {
  projectId: number;
  issueId: number;
  actorUserId: string | null;
  // The change-log entry the write recorded, so the inbox item links to it.
  sourceActivityId: number | null;
  before: string;
  after: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const { projectId, issueId, actorUserId: actor } = input;
  const handles = addedMentionHandles(input.before, input.after);
  if (handles.length === 0) return;
  const { memberIds } = await mentionReach(
    projectId,
    actor,
    { on: 'issue', place: 'text' },
    await resolveMentionHandles(projectId, handles),
  );
  if (memberIds.length === 0) return;
  await autoWatchIssue(projectId, issueId, memberIds);
  await insertNotifications(
    memberIds
      .filter((userId) => userId !== actor)
      .map((userId) => ({
        userId,
        projectId,
        issueId,
        sourceActivityId: input.sourceActivityId,
        type: 'mentioned' as const,
        actorUserId: actor,
      })),
  );
}

// Fan out issue field changes recorded by an update. A new assignee (if a member and
// not the actor) gets 'assigned'; a status change notifies the issue's watchers with
// 'state_changed'. The actor is never notified. Being assigned subscribes to the
// issue, and stays that way when the issue is later handed to someone else.
export async function notifyIssueChange(input: {
  projectId: number;
  issueId: number;
  actorUserId: string | null;
  assignedUserId?: string | null;
  assignedActivityId?: number | null;
  statusChanged?: boolean;
  statusActivityId?: number | null;
}): Promise<void> {
  const { projectId, issueId, actorUserId: actor } = input;
  const rows: NewNotificationRow[] = [];

  if (input.assignedUserId) {
    await autoWatchIssue(projectId, issueId, [input.assignedUserId]);
    if (input.assignedUserId !== actor) {
      const members = await keepProjectMembers(projectId, [input.assignedUserId]);
      if (members.has(input.assignedUserId)) {
        rows.push({
          userId: input.assignedUserId,
          projectId,
          issueId,
          sourceActivityId: input.assignedActivityId ?? null,
          type: 'assigned',
          actorUserId: actor,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  if (input.statusChanged) {
    const assigned = input.assignedUserId ?? null;
    const watchers = await watcherUserIds(projectId, issueId);
    for (const userId of watchers) {
      // Skip the actor and anyone already told they were just assigned.
      if (userId === actor || userId === assigned) continue;
      rows.push({
        userId,
        projectId,
        issueId,
        sourceActivityId: input.statusActivityId ?? null,
        type: 'state_changed',
        actorUserId: actor,
      });
    }
  }

  await insertNotifications(rows);
}

// Fan out a mention in a document: in its text, or in the comment documentCommentId
// names. The caller resolves who may read the document; the actor is left out here.
export async function notifyDocumentMentions(input: {
  projectId: number;
  documentId: number;
  documentCommentId: string | null;
  actorUserId: string | null;
  memberIds: string[];
}): Promise<void> {
  await insertNotifications(
    input.memberIds
      .filter((userId) => userId !== input.actorUserId)
      .map((userId) => ({
        userId,
        projectId: input.projectId,
        issueId: null,
        sourceActivityId: null,
        documentId: input.documentId,
        documentCommentId: input.documentCommentId,
        type: 'mentioned' as const,
        actorUserId: input.actorUserId,
      })),
  );
}

// --- Inbox read + mutations ------------------------------------------------------

// A notification enriched with the issue or the document and the project it points at,
// so the inbox can render a row (identifier or title, project, actor, status) without
// extra calls. The issue fields are null on a document's notification, the document
// fields on an issue's.
export interface NotificationRow {
  id: number;
  type: NotificationType;
  actorUserId: string | null;
  actorName: string | null;
  readAt: string | null;
  snoozedUntil: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  issueId: number | null;
  issueSeq: number | null;
  issueTitle: string | null;
  issueStateType: string | null;
  // Set while the issue comment it is about still exists.
  issueCommentId: number | null;
  documentId: number | null;
  documentTitle: string | null;
  documentIcon: string | null;
  // Set when the mention is in a comment on the document.
  documentCommentId: string | null;
  projectId: number;
  projectKey: string;
  projectName: string;
  // Only a 'state_changed' event has them, and only while its activity row lives.
  fromState: string | null;
  toState: string | null;
  // Only a 'reacted' event has it.
  reactionEmoji: string | null;
}

export interface NotificationCursor {
  ts: string;
  id: number;
}

export interface NotificationPage {
  items: NotificationRow[];
  nextCursor: NotificationCursor | null;
}

export interface NotificationFilters {
  types?: NotificationType[];
  fromUserId?: string;
  projectId?: number;
  includeRead?: boolean;
  includeSnoozed?: boolean;
  // Keeps only projects an MCP call may reach: the project and its team both have MCP on.
  mcpOnly?: boolean;
}

function mcpReachable() {
  return inArray(
    notification.projectId,
    db
      .select({ id: project.id })
      .from(project)
      .innerJoin(team, eq(team.id, project.teamId))
      .where(and(eq(project.mcpEnabled, true), eq(team.mcpEnabled, true))),
  );
}

function notificationConditions(userId: string, f: NotificationFilters) {
  const conds = [eq(notification.userId, userId)];
  if (f.types && f.types.length) conds.push(inArray(notification.type, f.types));
  if (f.fromUserId) conds.push(eq(notification.actorUserId, f.fromUserId));
  if (f.projectId != null) conds.push(eq(notification.projectId, f.projectId));
  if (f.includeRead === false) conds.push(isNull(notification.readAt));
  if (f.mcpOnly) conds.push(mcpReachable());
  if (!f.includeSnoozed)
    conds.push(or(isNull(notification.snoozedUntil), lt(notification.snoozedUntil, sql`now()`))!);
  return conds;
}

function mapRow(r: {
  id: number;
  type: string;
  actorUserId: string | null;
  actorName: string | null;
  readAt: Date | null;
  snoozedUntil: Date | null;
  createdAt: Date;
  issueId: number | null;
  issueSeq: number | null;
  issueTitle: string | null;
  issueStateType: string | null;
  activityId: number | null;
  activityKind: string | null;
  documentId: number | null;
  documentTitle: string | null;
  documentIcon: string | null;
  documentCommentId: string | null;
  projectId: number;
  projectKey: string;
  projectName: string;
  payload: ActivityPayload | null;
  reactionEmoji: string | null;
}): NotificationRow {
  const stateChange = r.type === 'state_changed';
  return {
    id: r.id,
    type: r.type as NotificationType,
    actorUserId: r.actorUserId,
    actorName: r.actorName,
    readAt: r.readAt ? iso(r.readAt) : null,
    snoozedUntil: r.snoozedUntil ? iso(r.snoozedUntil) : null,
    createdAt: iso(r.createdAt),
    issueId: r.issueId,
    issueSeq: r.issueSeq,
    issueTitle: r.issueTitle,
    issueStateType: r.issueStateType,
    issueCommentId: r.activityKind === 'comment' ? r.activityId : null,
    documentId: r.documentId,
    documentTitle: r.documentTitle,
    documentIcon: r.documentIcon,
    documentCommentId: r.documentCommentId,
    projectId: r.projectId,
    projectKey: r.projectKey,
    projectName: r.projectName,
    fromState: stateChange ? (r.payload?.from?.value ?? null) : null,
    toState: stateChange ? (r.payload?.to?.value ?? null) : null,
    reactionEmoji: r.reactionEmoji,
  };
}

// The document of a notification, joined only while the user may still open it: a page
// made private after it mentioned someone is hidden from them unless it is shared with
// them.
function visibleDocument(userId: string) {
  return and(eq(projectDocument.id, notification.documentId), documentVisibleTo(userId));
}

// A notification whose issue or document the user can still see.
const hasTarget = or(isNotNull(notification.issueId), isNotNull(projectDocument.id));

// One page of a user's inbox, newest first, keyset-paged on (created_at, id).
// Only projects the user is still a member of: the row carries the issue title, its
// current state, the document title and the project name read at query time, so a
// removed member must not reach them. includeRead defaults to true (the inbox shows
// read notifications too); a snoozed notification (snoozed_until still in the future)
// is hidden unless includeSnoozed. limit is clamped to 1..100.
export async function listNotifications(
  userId: string,
  opts: { before?: NotificationCursor | null; limit?: number; filters?: NotificationFilters } = {},
): Promise<NotificationPage> {
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(opts.limit ?? 30, 1), 100);
  const before = opts.before ?? null;
  const f = opts.filters ?? {};
  const conds = notificationConditions(userId, f);
  if (before)
    conds.push(
      sql`(${notification.createdAt}, ${notification.id}) < (${before.ts}::timestamptz, ${before.id}::integer)`,
    );

  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: notification.id,
      type: notification.type,
      actorUserId: notification.actorUserId,
      actorName: notification.actorName,
      readAt: notification.readAt,
      snoozedUntil: notification.snoozedUntil,
      createdAt: notification.createdAt,
      cursorTs: sql<string>`${notification.createdAt}::text`,
      issueId: notification.issueId,
      issueSeq: issue.sequenceNumber,
      issueTitle: issue.title,
      issueStateType: projectColumn.stateType,
      activityId: issueActivity.id,
      activityKind: issueActivity.kind,
      documentId: projectDocument.id,
      documentTitle: projectDocument.title,
      documentIcon: projectDocument.icon,
      documentCommentId: notification.documentCommentId,
      projectId: project.id,
      projectKey: project.key,
      projectName: project.name,
      payload: issueActivity.payload,
      reactionEmoji: notification.reactionEmoji,
    })
    .from(notification)
    .innerJoin(
      projectMember,
      and(eq(projectMember.projectId, notification.projectId), eq(projectMember.userId, userId)),
    )
    .innerJoin(project, eq(project.id, notification.projectId))
    .leftJoin(issue, eq(issue.id, notification.issueId))
    .leftJoin(projectColumn, eq(projectColumn.id, issue.columnId))
    .leftJoin(projectDocument, visibleDocument(userId))
    .leftJoin(issueActivity, eq(issueActivity.id, notification.sourceActivityId))
    .where(and(...conds, hasTarget))
    .orderBy(desc(notification.createdAt), desc(notification.id))
    .limit(limit + 1);

  const hasMore = rows.length > limit;
  const page = hasMore ? rows.slice(0, limit) : rows;
  const last = page[page.length - 1];
  return {
    items: page.map(mapRow),
    nextCursor: hasMore && last ? { ts: last.cursorTs, id: last.id } : null,
  };
}

// The number of unread, non-snoozed notifications for the inbox badge, optionally
// scoped to one project. Counts only what listNotifications shows.
export async function unreadCount(
  userId: string,
  projectId?: number,
  mcpOnly = false,
): Promise<number> {
  const conds = [
    eq(notification.userId, userId),
    isNull(notification.readAt),
    or(isNull(notification.snoozedUntil), lt(notification.snoozedUntil, sql`now()`)),
  ];
  if (projectId != null) conds.push(eq(notification.projectId, projectId));
  if (mcpOnly) conds.push(mcpReachable());
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ n: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
    .from(notification)
    .innerJoin(
      projectMember,
      and(eq(projectMember.projectId, notification.projectId), eq(projectMember.userId, userId)),
    )
    .leftJoin(projectDocument, visibleDocument(userId))
    .where(and(...conds, hasTarget));
  return row?.n ?? 0;
}

// Marks one of the user's notifications read or unread. Returns false if no such
// notification belongs to the user.
export async function setNotificationRead(
  userId: string,
  id: number,
  read: boolean,
  mcpOnly = false,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const rows = await db
    .update(notification)
    .set({ readAt: read ? sql`now()` : null })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(notification.id, id),
        eq(notification.userId, userId),
        mcpOnly ? mcpReachable() : undefined,
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: notification.id });
  return rows.length > 0;
}

// Marks the user's matching unread notifications read.
// Returns how many were updated.
export async function markAllRead(
  userId: string,
  projectId?: number,
  filters: NotificationFilters = { includeSnoozed: true },
): Promise<number> {
  const conds = notificationConditions(userId, { ...filters, projectId });
  conds.push(isNull(notification.readAt));
  const rows = await db
    .update(notification)
    .set({ readAt: sql`now()` })
    .where(and(...conds))
    .returning({ id: notification.id });
  return rows.length;
}

// Snoozes one of the user's notifications until the given time (null clears it).
// Returns false if no such notification belongs to the user.
export async function snoozeNotification(
  userId: string,
  id: number,
  until: Date | null,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const rows = await db
    .update(notification)
    .set({ snoozedUntil: until })
    .where(and(eq(notification.id, id), eq(notification.userId, userId)))
    .returning({ id: notification.id });
  return rows.length > 0;
}

// Deletes one of the user's notifications. Returns false if it did not belong to
// the user.
export async function deleteNotification(userId: string, id: number): Promise<boolean> {
  const rows = await db
    .delete(notification)
    .where(and(eq(notification.id, id), eq(notification.userId, userId)))
    .returning({ id: notification.id });
  return rows.length > 0;
}

export type DeleteScope = 'all' | 'read' | 'read-completed' | 'completed';

// Bulk-deletes matching notifications: all, read, read on completed/canceled issues,
// or all on completed/canceled issues. Returns how many were deleted.
export async function deleteNotifications(
  userId: string,
  scope: DeleteScope,
  projectId?: number,
  filters: NotificationFilters = { includeSnoozed: true },
): Promise<number> {
  // Completed deletes read and unread by design, so the inbox's show-read
  // toggle must not narrow it.
  const bulkFilters = scope === 'completed' ? { ...filters, includeRead: true } : filters;
  const conds = notificationConditions(userId, { ...bulkFilters, projectId });
  if (scope === 'read' || scope === 'read-completed')
    conds.push(sql`${notification.readAt} is not null`);
  if (scope === 'read-completed' || scope === 'completed') {
    const completedIssues = db
      .select({ id: issue.id })
      .from(issue)
      .innerJoin(projectColumn, eq(projectColumn.id, issue.columnId))
      .where(inArray(projectColumn.stateType, ['completed', 'canceled']));
    conds.push(inArray(notification.issueId, completedIssues));
  }
  const rows = await db
    .delete(notification)
    .where(and(...conds))
    .returning({ id: notification.id });
  return rows.length;
}

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'bun:test';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { db, notificationDelivery } from '@repo/db';
import { asc, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { authedApi, type Api, createProject } from '#tests/helpers/app';
import { signUpTestUser } from '#tests/helpers/auth';
import { resetDb } from '#tests/helpers/db';

// Notifications are fanned out when an issue changes and read back through the
// session user's inbox. The actor is never notified about their own action, and
// only project members receive notifications. New members join through invites, so
// a second member is added by creating and accepting an invite.

interface Member {
  api: Api;
  userId: string;
  username: string;
}

async function setup() {
  const u = await signUpTestUser();
  const api = authedApi(u.cookie);
  await createProject(api, { key: 'MKT', name: 'Marketing' });
  const view = await api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).get();
  const columns = view.data!.columns;
  const done = columns.find((c) => c.stateType === 'completed') ?? columns[columns.length - 1];
  return {
    owner: { api, userId: u.userId, username: u.username },
    project: view.data!.project,
    columnId: columns[0].id,
    doneColumnId: done.id,
  };
}

async function addMember(owner: Member): Promise<Member> {
  const u = await signUpTestUser();
  const invite = await owner.api
    .projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })
    .invites.post({ email: u.email, role: 'member' });
  const api = authedApi(u.cookie);
  await api.invites({ token: invite.data!.token }).accept.post();
  return { api, userId: u.userId, username: u.username };
}

function createIssue(client: Api, columnId: number, patch: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return client.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' }).issues.post({ columnId, title: 'Task', ...patch });
}

describe('notifications', () => {

    const client = owner.api.issues({ issueId: issue.id });
    await client.comments.post({ body: 'Please review' } as never);
    await client.patch({ description: `@${member.username} review this` });
    await client.patch({ columnId: doneColumnId });

    const before = (await member.api.notifications.get({ query: {} })).data!.items;
    expect(before.map((item) => item.type).sort()).toEqual([
      'assigned',
      'commented',
      'mentioned',
      'state_changed',
    ]);

      types: ['state_changed'],
      includeSnoozed: false,
    });
    expect(read.status).toBe(200);
    expect(read.data!.count).toBe(1);
    const afterRead = (await member.api.notifications.get({ query: {} })).data!.items;
    expect(afterRead.filter((item) => item.readAt != null).map((item) => item.type)).toEqual([
      'state_changed',
    ]);

    expect(deleted.data!.count).toBe(1);
    const remaining = (await member.api.notifications.get({ query: {} })).data!.items;
    expect(remaining.map((item) => item.type).sort()).toEqual([
      'assigned',
      'commented',
      'mentioned',
    ]);
    expect(remaining.every((item) => item.readAt != null)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('completed deletes unread and read notifications, and leaves active issues alone', async () => {
    const { owner, columnId, doneColumnId } = await setup();
    const member = await addMember(owner);
    const active = (await createIssue(owner.api, columnId, { assigneeUserId: member.userId }))

      await createIssue(owner.api, doneColumnId, { assigneeUserId: member.userId })
    ).data!;
    await owner.api.issues({ issueId: completed.id }).comments.post({ body: 'Done' } as never);

    const before = (await member.api.notifications.get({ query: {} })).data!.items;
    expect(before).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(
      before
        .filter((item) => item.issueId === completed.id)
        .map((item) => item.type)
        .sort(),
    ).toEqual(['assigned', 'commented']);
    expect(before.find((item) => item.issueId === active.id)!.type).toBe('assigned');
    expect(before.every((item) => item.readAt == null)).toBe(true);
    await member.api.notifications['read-all'].post({ types: ['commented'] });

    const assigned = await member.api.notifications.delete(undefined, {
      query: {
        scope: 'completed',
        types: 'assigned',
        includeRead: 'false',
        includeSnoozed: 'false',
      },
    });
    expect(assigned.data!.count).toBe(1);
    const afterAssigned = (await member.api.notifications.get({ query: {} })).data!.items;
    expect(afterAssigned.map((item) => item.issueId!).sort((a, b) => a - b)).toEqual(
      [active.id, completed.id].sort((a, b) => a - b),
    );
    expect(afterAssigned.find((item) => item.issueId === completed.id)!.readAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(afterAssigned.find((item) => item.issueId === active.id)!.readAt).toBeNull();

    const all = await member.api.notifications.delete(undefined, {
      query: { scope: 'completed', includeRead: 'false', includeSnoozed: 'false' },
    });
    expect(all.data!.count).toBe(1);
    const remaining = (await member.api.notifications.get({ query: {} })).data!.items;
    expect(remaining).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(remaining[0].issueId).toBe(active.id);
    expect(remaining[0].readAt).toBeNull();
  });

  it('bulk actions respect actor and snooze filters', async () => {

// Push is the instance's, not the team's: it is on while the WEB_PUSH_* variables are

describe('push notifications', () => {
  const ENV = ['WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY', 'WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY', 'WEB_PUSH_SUBJECT'];
  const none = {
    assigned: false,
    mentioned: false,
    commented: false,
    state_changed: false,
    reacted: false,
  };
  let saved: (string | undefined)[];

  beforeEach(async () => {
    saved = ENV.map((name) => process.env[name]);
    await resetDb();
    process.env.WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY =
      'BP4z9KsN6nGRTbVYI_c7VJSPQTBtkgcy27mlmlMoZIIgDll6e3vCYLocInmYWAmS6TlzAC8wEqKK6PBru3jl7A8';
    process.env.WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY = 'yfWPiYE-n46HLnH0KqZOF1fJJU3MYrct3AELtAQ-oRw';
    process.env.WEB_PUSH_SUBJECT = 'mailto:ops@example.com';
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    ENV.forEach((name, i) => {
      if (saved[i] === undefined) delete process.env[name];
      else process.env[name] = saved[i];
    });
  });

  async function subscribeBrowser(member: Member): Promise<number> {
    const pair = (await crypto.subtle.generateKey({ name: 'ECDH', namedCurve: 'P-256' }, true, [
      'deriveBits',
    ])) as CryptoKeyPair;
    const res = await member.api.push.subscriptions.post({
      endpoint: `https://example.com/push/${randomUUID()}`,
      keys: {
        p256dh: Buffer.from(await crypto.subtle.exportKey('raw', pair.publicKey)).toString(
          'base64url',
        ),
        auth: Buffer.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16))).toString('base64url'),
      },
    });
    return res.data!.id;
  }

  function queuedPushes() {
    return db
      .select({ recipient: notificationDelivery.recipient, payload: notificationDelivery.payload })
      .from(notificationDelivery)
      .where(eq(notificationDelivery.channel, 'push'))
      .orderBy(asc(notificationDelivery.id));
  }

  it('queues one push per browser for the events the member turned on', async () => {
    const { owner, project, columnId } = await setup();
    const member = await addMember(owner);
    const browsers = [await subscribeBrowser(member), await subscribeBrowser(member)];
    await member.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })['notification-preferences'].put({
      emailEvents: none,
      telegramEvents: none,
      pushEvents: { ...none, assigned: true },
    });

    const issue = (await createIssue(owner.api, columnId, { assigneeUserId: member.userId })).data!;
    await owner.api.issues({ issueId: issue.id }).comments.post({ body: 'Started on it' });

    const inbox = (await member.api.notifications.get({ query: {} })).data!.items;
    expect(inbox.map((n) => n.type).sort()).toEqual(['assigned', 'commented']);
    const assigned = inbox.find((n) => n.type === 'assigned');
    const queued = await queuedPushes();
    expect(queued.map((row) => Number(row.recipient)).sort()).toEqual(browsers.sort());
    for (const row of queued) {
      expect(row.payload).toEqual({
        title: `${issue.identifier} Task`,
        text: `Assigned by ${assigned!.actorName}`,
        url: `${process.env.APP_URL}/${project.teamRef}/issue/${issue.identifier}`,
        tag: `inbox-${assigned!.id}`,
      });
    }
  });

  it('queues no push for a browser that subscribed with keys the instance no longer has', async () => {
    const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
    const member = await addMember(owner);
    await subscribeBrowser(member);
    await member.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })['notification-preferences'].put({
      emailEvents: none,
      telegramEvents: none,
      pushEvents: { ...none, assigned: true },
    });
    // A new key pair: the push services refuse this instance's token for the browser above.
    process.env.WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY =
      'BCVxsr7N_eNgVRqvHtD0zTZsEc6-VV-JvLexhqUzORcxaOzi6-AYWXvTBHm4bjyPjs7Vd8pZGH6SRpkNtoIAiw4';
    process.env.WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY = 'q1dXpw3UpT5VOmu_cf_v6ih07Aems3njxI-JWgLcM94';
    const current = await subscribeBrowser(member);

    await createIssue(owner.api, columnId, { assigneeUserId: member.userId });

    expect((await queuedPushes()).map((row) => Number(row.recipient))).toEqual([current]);
  });

  it('queues no push while push is off', async () => {
    const { owner, columnId } = await setup();
    const member = await addMember(owner);
    await subscribeBrowser(member);
    const all = { assigned: true, mentioned: true, commented: true, state_changed: true };
    await member.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })['notification-preferences'].put({
      emailEvents: none,
      telegramEvents: none,
      pushEvents: all,
    });
    delete process.env.WEB_PUSH_SUBJECT;

    await createIssue(owner.api, columnId, { assigneeUserId: member.userId });

    expect(await queuedPushes()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('keeps the stored push events when a write leaves them out', async () => {
    const { owner } = await setup();
    const member = await addMember(owner);
    const prefs = member.api.projects({ projectKey: 'MKT' })['notification-preferences'];
    await prefs.put({
      emailEvents: none,
      telegramEvents: none,
      pushEvents: { ...none, mentioned: true },
    });

    const res = await prefs.put({ emailEvents: { ...none, assigned: true }, telegramEvents: none });

    expect(res.data).toEqual({
      emailEvents: { ...none, assigned: true },
      telegramEvents: none,
      pushEvents: { ...none, mentioned: true },
    });
  });
});
